```cc
#include "browser_scene.h"
#include "keyboard_scene.h"
#include "wifi_sta.h"
#include "ui.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <errno.h>

#define BROWSER_MAX_HTML 65536 // 64KB
#define BROWSER_MAX_TEXT 65536 // 64KB

static char s_html_buf[BROWSER_MAX_HTML]{ 0 };
static char s_text_buf[BROWSER_MAX_TEXT]{ 0 };

static int s_scroll_y = 0;
static int s_max_scroll_y = 0;
static bool s_is_loading = false;
static char s_loading_msg[128] = "Loading...";

static void StripHtmlToText(const char* html, char* text, int max_len) {

    int html_len = strlen(html);
    int t_idx = 0;
    bool in_tag = false;
    bool in_style = false;
    bool in_script = false;
    bool last_was_space = false;

    const char* body = strstr(html, "<body");
    if (!body) body = strstr(html, "<BODY");
    if (!body) body = html;

    int start_idx = body - html;

    for (int i = start_idx; i < html_len && t_idx < max_len - 1; i++) {

        char c = html[i];

        if (c == '<') {

            in_tag = true;
            if (strncasecmp(&html[i], "<script", 7) == 0) in_script = true;
            if (strncasecmp(&html[i], "</script", 8) == 0) in_script = false;
            if (strncasecmp(&html[i], "<style", 6) == 0) in_style = true;
            if (strncasecmp(&html[i], "</style", 7) == 0) in_style = false;

            if (strncasecmp(&html[i], "<p", 2) == 0 || strncasecmp(&html[i], "<br", 3) == 0 || strncasecmp(&html[i], "<div", 4) == 0 || strncasecmp(&html[i], "<h", 2) == 0) {

                if (t_idx > 0 && text[t_idx-1] != '\n') {

                    text[t_idx++] = '\n';
                    last_was_space = true;

                }

            }

            continue;
        }

        if (c == '>') { in_tag = false; continue; }

        if (!in_tag && !in_script && !in_style) {

            if (c == '\r') continue;
            if (c == '&' && html[i+1] == 'n' && html[i+2] == 'b' && html[i+3] == 's' && html[i+4] == 'p' && html[i+5] == ';') {
                c = ' '; i += 5;
            }
            if (c == '\n' || c == '\t' || c == ' ') {
                if (!last_was_space) { text[t_idx++] = ' '; last_was_space = true; }
            } else {

                text[t_idx++] = c;
                last_was_space = false;
            
            }

        }
    
    }

    text[t_idx] = '\0';
}

static int DecodeChunked(const char* src, int src_len, char* dst, int dst_size) {

    int si = 0, di = 0;
    while (si < src_len && di < dst_size - 1) {

        // Read chunk size (hex)
        char hex[16] = {0};
        int hi = 0;
        while (si < src_len && src[si] != '\r' && src[si] != '\n' && hi < 15) hex[hi++] = src[si++];

        // Skip \r\n after size line
        while (si < src_len && (src[si] == '\r' || src[si] == '\n')) si++;

        int chunk_size = (int)strtol(hex, NULL, 16);
        if (chunk_size == 0) break; // last chunk

        int copy = chunk_size;
        if (di + copy > dst_size - 1) copy = dst_size - 1 - di;
        memcpy(dst + di, src + si, copy);
        di += copy;
        si += chunk_size;

        // Skip \r\n after chunk data
        while (si < src_len && (src[si] == '\r' || src[si] == '\n')) si++;

    }

    dst[di] = '\0';

    return di;
}

static int HttpGetUrl(const char* url_in, char* out_buf, int out_size) {

    char host[128] = {0};
    char path[256] = "/";
    int port = 80;
    char current_url[512];
    strncpy(current_url, url_in, sizeof(current_url) - 1);

    for (int redirect = 0; redirect < 5; redirect++) {
    
        memset(host, 0, sizeof(host));
        strncpy(path, "/", sizeof(path) - 1);
        port = 80;

        const char* p = current_url;
        if (strncmp(p, "http://", 7) == 0) p += 7;
        else if (strncmp(p, "https://", 8) == 0) p += 8;

        const char* slash = strchr(p, '/');
        if (slash) {

            int h_len = slash - p;
            if (h_len >= (int)sizeof(host)) h_len = sizeof(host) - 1;
            strncpy(host, p, h_len);
            strncpy(path, slash, sizeof(path) - 1);

        } else 
            strncpy(host, p, sizeof(host) - 1);

        char* colon = strchr(host, ':');
        if (colon) { *colon = '\0'; port = atoi(colon + 1); }
        if (strlen(host) == 0) return -1;

        fprintf(stderr, "[WEB] -> %s:%d%s\n", host, port, path);

        int sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (sockfd < 0) return -1;

        struct timeval tv;
        tv.tv_sec = 15; tv.tv_usec = 0;
        setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
        setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));

        struct hostent *server = gethostbyname(host);
        if (!server) { close(sockfd); return -1; }

        struct sockaddr_in serv_addr;
        memset(&serv_addr, 0, sizeof(serv_addr));
        serv_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
        serv_addr.sin_port = htons(port);
        memcpy(&serv_addr.sin_addr.s_addr, server->h_addr, server->h_length);

        if (connect(sockfd, (struct sockaddr *)&serv_addr, sizeof(serv_addr)) < 0) {
            close(sockfd); return -1;
        }

        char request[512];
        snprintf(request, sizeof(request),
                 "GET %s HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                 "Host: %s\r\n"
                 "User-Agent: Lelouch/1.0 (SJCAM)\r\n"
                 "Accept: text/html, text/plain\r\n"
                 "Connection: close\r\n\r\n",
                 path, host
        );

        if (send(sockfd, request, strlen(request), 0) < 0) { close(sockfd); return -1; }

        int total = 0;
        while (total < out_size - 1) {

            int bytes = recv(sockfd, out_buf + total, out_size - 1 - total, 0);
            if (bytes <= 0) break;
            total += bytes;
        
        }
        out_buf[total] = '\0';
        close(sockfd);

        if (total <= 0) return -1;

        // Check HTTP status for redirect
        int status = 0;
        sscanf(out_buf, "HTTP/%*d.%*d %d", &status);

        if (status == 301 || status == 302 || status == 303 || status == 307 || status == 308) {

            char* loc = strstr(out_buf, "Location:");
            if (!loc) loc = strstr(out_buf, "location:");
            if (loc) {

                loc += 9;
                while (*loc == ' ') loc++;
                char new_url[512] = {0};
                int ui = 0;
                while (*loc && *loc != '\r' && *loc != '\n' && ui < (int)sizeof(new_url) - 1)
                    new_url[ui++] = *loc++;
                new_url[ui] = '\0';

                fprintf(stderr, "[WEB] Redirect %d -> %s\n", status, new_url);
                strncpy(current_url, new_url, sizeof(current_url) - 1);

                continue;
            }

        }

        // Find header/body separator
        char* body_start = strstr(out_buf, "\r\n\r\n");
        if (!body_start) body_start = strstr(out_buf, "\n\n");
        if (!body_start) return total;

        bool is_chunked = (strstr(out_buf, "Transfer-Encoding: chunked") != NULL ||
                           strstr(out_buf, "transfer-encoding: chunked") != NULL);

        int header_len = (body_start - out_buf) + (body_start[0] == '\r' ? 4 : 2);
        const char* raw_body = out_buf + header_len;
        int raw_body_len = total - header_len;

        if (is_chunked) {

            static char s_chunk_tmp[BROWSER_MAX_HTML]{ 0 };
            int decoded_len = DecodeChunked(raw_body, raw_body_len, s_chunk_tmp, sizeof(s_chunk_tmp));
            memcpy(out_buf, s_chunk_tmp, decoded_len + 1);
            
            return decoded_len;
        } else {

            memmove(out_buf, raw_body, raw_body_len + 1);
            
            return raw_body_len;
        }

    }

    return -1;
}

static volatile int s_wifi_check_result = -1; // KEW: -1 = pending, 0 = no ip, 1 = got ip
static bool s_wifi_check_running = false;

static void* WifiCheckThread(void* arg) {

    (void)arg; // Fuck compile warning crap shit
    
    FILE* fp = popen("ifconfig wlan0 2>/dev/null", "r");
    if (!fp) { s_wifi_check_result = 0; return NULL; }

    char line[256];
    int ok = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {
    
        char* p = strstr(line, "inet addr:");
        if (p) { p += 10; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }
        p = strstr(line, " ip ");
        if (p) { p += 4; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }
        p = strstr(line, "inet ");
        if (p) { p += 5; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strncmp(p, "127.", 4) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }
    
    }
    
    pclose(fp);
    s_wifi_check_result = ok;
    
    return NULL;
}

static void SpawnWifiCheck() {

    if (s_wifi_check_running) return;
    
    s_wifi_check_result = -1;
    s_wifi_check_running = true;

    pthread_t tid;
    pthread_create(&tid, NULL, WifiCheckThread, NULL);
    pthread_detach(tid);

}

static int CheckWifiIp() {

    FILE* fp = popen("ifconfig wlan0 2>/dev/null", "r");
    if (!fp) return 0;
    char line[256];
    int ok = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {

        char* p = strstr(line, "inet addr:");
        if (p) { p += 10; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }
        p = strstr(line, " ip ");
        if (p) { p += 4; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }
        p = strstr(line, "inet ");
        if (p) { p += 5; if (strncmp(p, "0.0.0.0", 7) != 0 && strncmp(p, "127.", 4) != 0 && strlen(p) > 7) { ok = 1; break; } }

    }

    pclose(fp);

    return ok;
}

struct LoadTaskArgs {

    HWND hWnd;
    char url[256];

};

static void* WebLoadThread(void* arg) {

    struct LoadTaskArgs* args = (struct LoadTaskArgs*)arg;

    memset(s_html_buf, 0, sizeof(s_html_buf));
    memset(s_text_buf, 0, sizeof(s_text_buf));
    s_scroll_y = 0;

    int len = HttpGetUrl(args->url, s_html_buf, sizeof(s_html_buf));
    if (len <= 0)
        snprintf(s_text_buf, sizeof(s_text_buf), "Failed to load URL:\n%s\n\nSocket error or host not found.", args->url);
    else
        StripHtmlToText(s_html_buf, s_text_buf, sizeof(s_text_buf)); // HttpGetUrl already stripped headers and decoded chunked

    s_is_loading = false;
    
    InvalidateRect(args->hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
    UpdateWindow(args->hWnd, TRUE);
    
    free(args);

    return NULL;
}

static bool s_browser_running = false;

static int BrowserWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

    HDC hdc;

    switch (message) {

        case MSG_CREATE:
            s_scroll_y = 0;
            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYDOWN:
            if (s_is_loading) {

                if (wParam == 0x83) PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                return 0;
            }
            if (wParam == 0x80) {

                s_scroll_y += 20;
                if (s_scroll_y > 0) s_scroll_y = 0;

                InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
                UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            } else if (wParam == 0x81) {

                s_scroll_y -= 20;

                InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
                UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            } else if (wParam == 0x83) {
             
                PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);
            
            }
            return 0;

        case MSG_PAINT: {
            
            hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);
            SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);
            SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 0, 0, 0));

            if (s_is_loading) {
            
                TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 40, WINDOW_HEIGHT / 2, s_loading_msg);
                EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);
            
                return 0;
            }

            int x = 5;
            int y = s_scroll_y + 5;
            int line_h = 16;
            int char_w = 8;
            int max_chars_per_line = (WINDOW_WIDTH - 10) / char_w;

            char* p = s_text_buf;
            char line_buf[128];

            while (*p && y < WINDOW_HEIGHT) {
            
                int ptr = 0;
                while (*p && *p != '\n' && ptr < max_chars_per_line) {
                    line_buf[ptr++] = *p++;
                }
                line_buf[ptr] = '\0';
            
                if (*p == '\n') p++;
                if (y > -line_h) TextOut(hdc, x, y, line_buf);
                y += line_h;
            
            }

            s_max_scroll_y = -(y - s_scroll_y) + WINDOW_HEIGHT;
            if (s_scroll_y < s_max_scroll_y) {
            
                s_scroll_y = s_max_scroll_y;
                if (s_scroll_y > 0) s_scroll_y = 0;
            
            }

            SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 200, 200, 210));
            FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, 20);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 50, 50, 50));
            TextOut(hdc, 5, 2, "MiniWeb");

            EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);
            
            return 0;
        }

        case MSG_CLOSE:
            s_browser_running = false;
            DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
            return 0;
    }

    return DefaultMainWinProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

static bool s_wifi_connected = false;
static int s_wifi_waits = 0;
static bool s_wait_wifi_running = false;

static int WaitWifiWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

    HDC hdc;
    switch (message) {

        case MSG_CREATE:

        s_wifi_connected = false;
            s_wifi_waits = 0;
            s_wifi_check_running = false;
            s_wifi_check_result = -1;
            SetTimer(hWnd, 500, 100);
            SpawnWifiCheck();

            return 0;

        case MSG_TIMER:
            if (s_wifi_check_result == 1) {

                s_wifi_check_running = false;
                s_wifi_connected = true;
                PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                return 0;
            } else if (s_wifi_check_result == 0) {

                s_wifi_check_running = false;
                s_wifi_waits++;

                if (s_wifi_waits >= 90) {

                    s_wifi_connected = false;
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                    return 0;
                }

                if ((s_wifi_waits % 2) == 0) SpawnWifiCheck();
            }

            InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
            UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYDOWN:
            if (wParam == 0x83) {

                s_wifi_connected = false;
                PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

            }

            return 0;

        case MSG_PAINT:

            hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);
            RestoreDC(hdc, -1);
            SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 20, 20, 30));
            FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);
            SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 70, WINDOW_HEIGHT / 2, "Connecting to WiFi...");
            char wait_buf[32];
            snprintf(wait_buf, sizeof(wait_buf), "Time: %d / 90 s", s_wifi_waits);
            TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 40, WINDOW_HEIGHT / 2 + 20, wait_buf);
            EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);

            return 0;

        case MSG_CLOSE:
    
            s_wait_wifi_running = false;
            KillTimer(hWnd, 500);
            DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
    
            return 0;
    }
    
    return DefaultMainWinProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

static bool RunWaitWifiScene() {
    
    MSG Msg;
    MAINWINCREATE C;
    HWND w;

    s_wait_wifi_running = true;

    memset(&C, 0, sizeof(C));
    C.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS;
    C.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
    C.spCaption = "WaitWiFi";
    C.MainWindowProc = WaitWifiWinProc;
    C.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH;
    C.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;
    C.iBkColor = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 20, 20, 30);
    C.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;
    w = CreateMainWindowEx(&C, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    if (w == HWND_INVALID) return false;
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNORMAL);

    while (s_wait_wifi_running && GetMessage(&Msg, w)) {
    
        TranslateMessage(&Msg);
        DispatchMessage(&Msg);
    
    }
    
    return s_wifi_connected;
}

void RunBrowserScene() {
    
    if (!CheckWifiIp()) {

        char ssid[128]{ 0 };
        char pass[128]{ 0 };
        memset(ssid, 0, sizeof(ssid));
        memset(pass, 0, sizeof(pass));

        if (!RunKeyboardScene("SSID:", ssid, sizeof(ssid))) return;
        if (!RunKeyboardScene("Pass:", pass, sizeof(pass))) return;

        wifi_sta_config_t* cfg = (wifi_sta_config_t*)malloc(sizeof(wifi_sta_config_t));
        strncpy(cfg->ssid, ssid, sizeof(cfg->ssid)-1);
        strncpy(cfg->password, pass, sizeof(cfg->password)-1);

        pthread_t tid;
        pthread_create(&tid, NULL, wifi_sta_thread, cfg);
        pthread_detach(tid);

        if (!RunWaitWifiScene()) return;

    }

    char url[256] = {0};
    if (!RunKeyboardScene("URL (no http:// needed):", url, sizeof(url))) return;
    if (strlen(url) == 0) return;

    MSG Msg;
    MAINWINCREATE C;
    HWND w;
    memset(&C, 0, sizeof(C));
    C.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS;
    C.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
    C.spCaption = "Browser";
    C.MainWindowProc = BrowserWinProc;
    C.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH;
    C.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;
    C.iBkColor = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255);
    C.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;
    w = CreateMainWindowEx(&C, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    if (w == HWND_INVALID) return;
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNORMAL);

    s_is_loading = true;
    snprintf(s_loading_msg, sizeof(s_loading_msg), "Loading %s...", url);

    struct LoadTaskArgs* args = (struct LoadTaskArgs*)malloc(sizeof(struct LoadTaskArgs));
    args->hWnd = w;
    strncpy(args->url, url, sizeof(args->url)-1);

    pthread_t fetch_tid;
    pthread_create(&fetch_tid, NULL, WebLoadThread, args);
    pthread_detach(fetch_tid);

    s_browser_running = true;
    while (s_browser_running && GetMessage(&Msg, w)) {

        TranslateMessage(&Msg);
        DispatchMessage(&Msg);
    
    }

}
```

`Lelouch/src/camera.cc`:

```cc
#include "camera.h"
#include "framebuffer.h"

#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define HW_DISPLAY_W 240
#define HW_DISPLAY_H 320

using namespace android;

HerbCamera *mHC = NULL;
CedarDisplay *mCD = NULL;
int mLayerId = -1;
volatile char camera_status[128] = "Camera: Initializing...";
volatile int camera_init_done = 0;

#include "cv_lite.h"

static CvContext g_cv;
static MotionResult g_motion;
static FaceResult g_face;

static pthread_t g_face_thread;
static pthread_mutex_t g_face_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_face_cond = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static volatile int g_face_thread_running = 0;
static volatile int g_face_request_pending = 0;
static uint8_t g_face_gray_buffer[CV_W * CV_H];
static FaceResult g_face_result_temp;

static const char *CASCADE_PATHS[] = {"/mnt/extsd/frontalface.casc", NULL};

class CameraPreviewCallback : public HerbCamera::PreviewCallback {
public:
  virtual void onPreviewFrame(void *data, int size, HerbCamera *pCamera) {
    if (!data || !camera_init_done || mLayerId < 0) {
      return;
    }

    const uint8_t *nv21 = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);

    static int skip_counter = 0;
    skip_counter++;
    if (skip_counter % 3 != 0) {
      return;
    }

    uint8_t gray[CV_W * CV_H];
    cv_nv21_to_gray(nv21, gray);
    cv_detect_motion(&g_cv, gray, &g_motion);
    g_cv.frames_processed++;
    
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_face_mutex);
    if (g_face.found && (g_cv.frames_processed - g_face.detected_frame) > 90) {
      g_face.found = 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_face_mutex);

    if (g_motion.active && g_face.found) {
      snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "OK L=%d MOV+FACE (%d,%d)",
               mLayerId, g_face.x / 3, g_face.y / 3);
    } else if (g_motion.active) {
      snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "OK L=%d MOV lv=%d",
               mLayerId, g_motion.level);
    } else if (g_face.found) {
      snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "OK L=%d FACE sc=%d",
               mLayerId, g_face.score);
    } else {
      snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "OK L=%d CV f=%d",
               mLayerId, g_cv.frames_processed);
    }
  }
};

static CameraPreviewCallback g_camera_preview_cb;

void *face_detection_thread(void *arg) {
  uint8_t local_gray[CV_W * CV_H];
  
  while (g_face_thread_running) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_face_mutex);
    
    while (g_face_thread_running && !g_face_request_pending) {
      pthread_cond_wait(&g_face_cond, &g_face_mutex);
    }
    
    if (!g_face_thread_running) {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_face_mutex);
      break;
    }
    
    memcpy(local_gray, g_face_gray_buffer, CV_W * CV_H);
    g_face_request_pending = 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_face_mutex);
    
    cv_build_integral(&g_cv, local_gray);
    cv_detect_face(&g_cv, &g_face_result_temp);
    
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_face_mutex);
    memcpy(&g_face, &g_face_result_temp, sizeof(FaceResult));
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_face_mutex);
  }
  
  return NULL;
}

void *camera_thread(void *arg) {
  sleep(2);

  if (mCD) {
    if (mLayerId >= 0) {
      mCD->releaseSurface(mLayerId);
      mLayerId = -1;
    }
    delete mCD;
    mCD = NULL;
  }

  if (mHC) {
    mHC->stopPreview();
    mHC->setPreviewCallback(NULL);
    mHC->release();
    mHC = NULL;
  }

  const char *cascade_found = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; CASCADE_PATHS[i]; i++) {
    FILE *test = fopen(CASCADE_PATHS[i], "rb");
    if (test) {
      fclose(test);
      cascade_found = CASCADE_PATHS[i];
      break;
    }
  }

  cv_init(&g_cv, cascade_found);

  if (g_cv.cascade_loaded) {
    g_face_thread_running = 1;
    pthread_create(&g_face_thread, NULL, face_detection_thread, NULL);
  }

  mHC = HerbCamera::open(0);
  if (!mHC) {
    snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "ERROR: Open");
    return NULL;
  }

  HerbCamera::Parameters params;
  mHC->getParameters(&params);
  params.setVideoSize(1920, 1080);
  params.setPreviewSize(CAM_W, CAM_H);
  params.setPreviewFrameRate(30);
  params.setPreviewFormat(HerbCamera::IMAGE_FORMAT_NV21);
  params.setPreviewRotation(90);
  params.setPreviewFlip(HerbCamera::Parameters::PREVIEW_FLIP::NoFlip);
  mHC->setParameters(&params);

  mCD = new CedarDisplay(0);
  if (!mCD) {
    snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "ERROR: Display");
    return NULL;
  }

  struct view_info sur;
  memset(&sur, 0, sizeof(sur));
  sur.x = 0;
  sur.y = 0;
  sur.w = HW_DISPLAY_W;
  sur.h = HW_DISPLAY_H;

  mLayerId = mCD->requestSurface(&sur);
  if (mLayerId < 0) {
    snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "ERROR: Surf");
    return NULL;
  }

  mHC->setPreviewDisplay(mLayerId);
  camera_init_done = 1;
  snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "OK L=%d CV=ready", mLayerId);

  mHC->setPreviewCallback(&g_camera_preview_cb);

  if (mHC->startPreview() != 0) {
    camera_init_done = 0;
    snprintf(const_cast<char*>(camera_status), sizeof(camera_status), "ERROR: Start");
    return NULL;
  }

  while (1) {
    sleep(10);
  }

  return NULL;
}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <CedarDisplay.h>
#include <HerbCamera.h>

using namespace android;

/**
 * camera.h
 *
 * Camera subsystem: HerbCamera + CedarDisplay hardware layer setup.
 * The camera runs in its own POSIX thread so that the MiniGUI message loop
 * is never blocked during the potentially slow camera open/configure sequence
 * similar to the one in the original sjcam firmware.
 */

// Shared camera state (read-only for UI layer)
extern HerbCamera *mHC;
extern CedarDisplay *mCD;
extern int mLayerId;
extern volatile char camera_status[128];
extern volatile int camera_init_done;

/** Thread entry-point: opens, configures and starts the camera preview. */
void *camera_thread(void *arg);

/** Log function for debugging (writes to /mnt/extsd/cv_debug.log and stderr) */
void log_to_file(const char *format, ...);
```

`Lelouch/src/cv_lite.cc`:

```cc
#include "cv_lite.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>

#define CASCADE_MAGIC 0x43415343

#pragma pack(push, 1)
typedef struct {
    uint8_t  x, y, w, h;
    float    weight;
} CascRect;

typedef struct {
    float    threshold;
    float    left_val;
    float    right_val;
    uint32_t num_rects;
    CascRect rects[3];     // max 3 rects per Haar feature
} CascWeak;

typedef struct {
    float     stage_threshold;
    uint32_t  num_weak;
    CascWeak *weak;        // block allocated on load
} CascStage;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t   magic;
    uint32_t   version;
    uint32_t   win_w;
    uint32_t   win_h;
    uint32_t   num_stages;
    CascStage *stages;     // block allocated on load
} Cascade;

#pragma pack(pop)

static int cv_ms_now() {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (int)(ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000);
}

void *cv_cascade_load(const char *path) {
    if (!path)
      return NULL;

    Cascade *c = NULL;

    FILE *fp = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!fp) {
      return NULL;
    }

    uint32_t hdr[5];
    if (fread(hdr, sizeof(uint32_t), 5, fp) != 5)
      goto err_close;

    if (hdr[0] != CASCADE_MAGIC) {
      goto err_close;
    }

    c = static_cast<Cascade*>(calloc(1, sizeof(Cascade)));
    if (!c)
      goto err_close;

    c->magic = hdr[0];
    c->version = hdr[1];
    c->win_w = hdr[2];
    c->win_h = hdr[3];
    c->num_stages = hdr[4];

    if (c->num_stages == 0 || c->num_stages > 512) goto err_free_c;

    c->stages = static_cast<CascStage*>(calloc(c->num_stages, sizeof(CascStage)));
    if (!c->stages) goto err_free_c;

    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < c->num_stages; s++) {
        CascStage *stage = &c->stages[s];

        if (fread(&stage->stage_threshold, sizeof(float), 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
        if (fread(&stage->num_weak, sizeof(uint32_t), 1, fp) != 1)      goto err_free_stages;

        if (stage->num_weak == 0 || stage->num_weak > 2048) goto err_free_stages;

        stage->weak = static_cast<CascWeak*>(calloc(stage->num_weak, sizeof(CascWeak)));
        if (!stage->weak) goto err_free_stages;

        for (uint32_t w = 0; w < stage->num_weak; w++) {
            CascWeak *wk = &stage->weak[w];
            if (fread(&wk->threshold,  sizeof(float),    1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
            if (fread(&wk->left_val,   sizeof(float),    1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
            if (fread(&wk->right_val,  sizeof(float),    1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
            if (fread(&wk->num_rects,  sizeof(uint32_t), 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;

            uint32_t nr = wk->num_rects;
            if (nr > 3) {
                nr = 3;
            }
            for (uint32_t r = 0; r < nr; r++) {
                // Read CascRect: 4 bytes (x,y,w,h) + 4 bytes (float weight) = 8 bytes total
                if (fread(&wk->rects[r].x, 1, 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
                if (fread(&wk->rects[r].y, 1, 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
                if (fread(&wk->rects[r].w, 1, 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
                if (fread(&wk->rects[r].h, 1, 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
                if (fread(&wk->rects[r].weight, sizeof(float), 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
            }
            // Skip extra rects if num_rects > 3
            for (uint32_t r = nr; r < wk->num_rects; r++) {
                uint8_t dummy[8];
                if (fread(dummy, 8, 1, fp) != 1) goto err_free_stages;
            }
        }
    }

    fclose(fp);
    return static_cast<void*>(c);

err_free_stages:
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < c->num_stages; s++)
        if (c->stages[s].weak) free(c->stages[s].weak);
    free(c->stages);
err_free_c:
    free(c);
err_close:
    fclose(fp);
    return NULL;
}

void cv_cascade_free(void *cascade) {
    if (!cascade) return;
    Cascade *c = static_cast<Cascade*>(cascade);
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < c->num_stages; s++)
        if (c->stages[s].weak) free(c->stages[s].weak);
    free(c->stages);
    free(c);
}

int cv_init(CvContext *ctx, const char *cascade_path) {
    if (!ctx) return -1;
    memset(ctx, 0, sizeof(CvContext));

    ctx->motion_threshold = 10;
    ctx->motion_cooldown  = 10;

    if (cascade_path) {
        ctx->cascade = cv_cascade_load(cascade_path);
        ctx->cascade_loaded = (ctx->cascade != NULL) ? 1 : 0;
    }

    return 0;
}

void cv_destroy(CvContext *ctx) {

    if (!ctx) return;

    if (ctx->cascade) {
        cv_cascade_free(ctx->cascade);
        ctx->cascade = NULL;
    }

    ctx->cascade_loaded = 0;
}

void cv_nv21_to_gray(const uint8_t *nv21, uint8_t *out) {

    const int y_start = (CAM_H - CV_H * 3) / 2;

    for (int oy = 0; oy < CV_H; oy++) {
        int iy = y_start + oy * 3;
        for (int ox = 0; ox < CV_W; ox++) {
            int ix = ox * 3;
            // 3x3 block average - avoids aliasing
            uint32_t sum =
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+0)*CAM_W + (ix+0)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+0)*CAM_W + (ix+1)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+0)*CAM_W + (ix+2)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+1)*CAM_W + (ix+0)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+1)*CAM_W + (ix+1)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+1)*CAM_W + (ix+2)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+2)*CAM_W + (ix+0)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+2)*CAM_W + (ix+1)] +
                (uint32_t)nv21[(iy+2)*CAM_W + (ix+2)];
            out[oy * CV_W + ox] = static_cast<uint8_t>(sum / 9);
        }
    }

}

int cv_detect_motion(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *gray, MotionResult *result) {

    if (!ctx || !gray || !result) return 0;

    memset(result, 0, sizeof(MotionResult));
    result->frame_count = ctx->frames_processed;

    if (ctx->frames_processed == 0) {
        memcpy(ctx->prev, gray, CV_W * CV_H);
        return 0;
    }

    // Cooldown: ignore N frames after an event, but keep updating prev buffer
    if (ctx->motion_cooldown_counter > 0) {
        ctx->motion_cooldown_counter--;
        memcpy(ctx->prev, gray, CV_W * CV_H);
        return 0;
    }

    #define BLOCK_SZ 10
    #define BLOCKS_X (CV_W / BLOCK_SZ)
    #define BLOCKS_Y (CV_H / BLOCK_SZ)

    long total_diff = 0;
    int  best_block_x = 0, best_block_y = 0;
    long best_block_sum = 0;

    for (int by = 0; by < BLOCKS_Y; by++) {
        for (int bx = 0; bx < BLOCKS_X; bx++) {
            long block_sum = 0;
            for (int py = 0; py < BLOCK_SZ; py++) {
                int row = by * BLOCK_SZ + py;
                for (int px = 0; px < BLOCK_SZ; px++) {
                    int col = bx * BLOCK_SZ + px;
                    int idx = row * CV_W + col;
                    int d = (int)gray[idx] - (int)ctx->prev[idx];
                    if (d < 0) d = -d;
                    block_sum += d;
                }
            }
            total_diff += block_sum;
            if (block_sum > best_block_sum) {
                best_block_sum = block_sum;
                best_block_x   = bx;
                best_block_y   = by;
            }
        }
    }

    int avg_diff = static_cast<int>(total_diff / (CV_W * CV_H));

    int hx_cv = best_block_x * BLOCK_SZ + BLOCK_SZ / 2;
    int hy_cv = best_block_y * BLOCK_SZ + BLOCK_SZ / 2;

    result->level     = avg_diff;
    result->hotspot_x = hx_cv * 3;
    result->hotspot_y = (hy_cv * 3) + (CAM_H - CV_H*3)/2;

    memcpy(ctx->prev, gray, CV_W * CV_H);

    if (avg_diff >= ctx->motion_threshold) {
        result->active = 1;
        ctx->motion_cooldown_counter = ctx->motion_cooldown;
        ctx->motion_events_total++;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

void cv_build_integral(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *gray) {

    int32_t *ii = ctx->integral;

    for (int y = 0; y < CV_H; y++) {
        int32_t row_sum = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < CV_W; x++) {
            row_sum += gray[y * CV_W + x];
            ii[y * CV_W + x] = row_sum + (y > 0 ? ii[(y-1)*CV_W + x] : 0);
        }
    }

    int32_t *ii_sq = ctx->integral_sq;
    for (int y = 0; y < CV_H; y++) {
        int32_t row_sum = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < CV_W; x++) {
            int v = gray[y * CV_W + x];
            row_sum += static_cast<int32_t>(v * v);
            ii_sq[y * CV_W + x] = row_sum + (y > 0 ? ii_sq[(y-1)*CV_W + x] : 0);
        }
    }

}

static inline int32_t ii_area(const int32_t *ii, int x, int y, int w, int h) {

    // Bounds check
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return 0;
    if (x >= CV_W || y >= CV_H) return 0;
    
    int x2 = x + w - 1;
    int y2 = y + h - 1;
    
    // Clamp to image bounds
    if (x2 >= CV_W) x2 = CV_W - 1;
    if (y2 >= CV_H) y2 = CV_H - 1;
    
    int32_t A = (x  > 0 && y  > 0) ? ii[(y-1)*CV_W + (x-1)] : 0;
    int32_t B = (y  > 0)            ? ii[(y-1)*CV_W + x2]     : 0;
    int32_t C = (x  > 0)            ? ii[y2*CV_W   + (x-1)]   : 0;
    int32_t D =                       ii[y2*CV_W   + x2];

    return D - B - C + A;
}

static float eval_weak(const CascWeak *wk, const int32_t *ii, int win_x, int win_y, float scale, float inv_area, float mean, float stddev) {
    
    float feature_val = 0.0f;

    for (uint32_t r = 0; r < wk->num_rects && r < 3; r++) {
        const CascRect *rc = &wk->rects[r];
        int rx = win_x + (int)(rc->x * scale);
        int ry = win_y + (int)(rc->y * scale);
        int rw = (int)(rc->w * scale);
        int rh = (int)(rc->h * scale);

        // Clamp to image bounds
        if (rx < 0) rx = 0;
        if (ry < 0) ry = 0;
        if (rx + rw > CV_W) rw = CV_W - rx;
        if (ry + rh > CV_H) rh = CV_H - ry;
        if (rw <= 0 || rh <= 0) continue;

        feature_val += rc->weight * static_cast<float>(ii_area(ii, rx, ry, rw, rh));
    }

    if (stddev > 1e-6f)
        feature_val *= inv_area / stddev;

    return (feature_val < wk->threshold * stddev) ? wk->left_val : wk->right_val;
}

int cv_detect_face(CvContext *ctx, FaceResult *result) {

    if (!ctx || !result) return 0;

    memset(result, 0, sizeof(FaceResult));

    if (!ctx->cascade_loaded || !ctx->cascade) {
        result->found = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    Cascade *c  = static_cast<Cascade*>(ctx->cascade);
    int32_t *ii = ctx->integral;
    int32_t *ii_sq = ctx->integral_sq;

    int t_start = cv_ms_now();
    
    int32_t total_sum = ii[(CV_H-1) * CV_W + (CV_W-1)];
    int mean_brightness = total_sum / (CV_W * CV_H);
    
    if (mean_brightness < 10) {
        result->found = 0;
        result->scan_ms = 0;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int32_t total_sum_sq = ii_sq[(CV_H-1) * CV_W + (CV_W-1)];
    float mean_sq = static_cast<float>(total_sum_sq) / (CV_W * CV_H);
    float variance = mean_sq - static_cast<float>(mean_brightness * mean_brightness);
    
    if (variance < 100.0f) {
        result->found = 0;
        result->scan_ms = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    int best_score = -1;
    int best_x = 0, best_y = 0, best_w = 0, best_h = 0;

    float scale = 1.0f;
    int windows_tested = 0;
    const int MAX_WINDOWS = 2000;
    
    while (scale <= 2.5f) {
        int win_w = static_cast<int>(c->win_w * scale);
        int win_h = static_cast<int>(c->win_h * scale);

        if (win_w > CV_W || win_h > CV_H) break;

        float inv_area = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(win_w * win_h);
        int step = static_cast<int>(4 * scale);
        if (step < 4) step = 4;

        for (int wy = 0; wy + win_h <= CV_H; wy += step) {
            for (int wx = 0; wx + win_w <= CV_W; wx += step) {
                
                windows_tested++;
                
                if (windows_tested > MAX_WINDOWS) {
                    goto scan_done;
                }

                float area_sum = static_cast<float>(ii_area(ii, wx, wy, win_w, win_h));
                float area_sum_sq = static_cast<float>(ii_area(ii_sq, wx, wy, win_w, win_h));
                float mean = area_sum * inv_area;
                float variance = area_sum_sq * inv_area - mean * mean;
                if (variance < 0.0f) variance = 0.0f;
                float stddev = (variance > 1e-6f) ? __builtin_sqrtf(variance) : 1.0f;

                int passed = 1;
                int score = 0;

                for (uint32_t s = 0; s < c->num_stages; s++) {
                    CascStage *stage = &c->stages[s];
                    float stage_sum = 0.0f;

                    for (uint32_t w = 0; w < stage->num_weak; w++) {
                        stage_sum += eval_weak(&stage->weak[w], ii,
                                               wx, wy, scale, inv_area, mean, stddev);
                    }

                    if (stage_sum < stage->stage_threshold) {
                        passed = 0;
                        break;
                    }

                    score++;
                }

                if (passed && score > best_score) {
                    best_score = score;
                    best_x = wx;
                    best_y = wy;
                    best_w = win_w;
                    best_h = win_h;
                }
            }
        }

        scale *= 1.25f;
    }

scan_done:
    result->scan_ms = cv_ms_now() - t_start;
    result->windows_tested = windows_tested;

    if (best_score >= 0 && best_score == static_cast<int>(c->num_stages)) {
        
        if (best_x <= 2 || best_y <= 2 || 
            best_x + best_w >= CV_W - 2 || 
            best_y + best_h >= CV_H - 2) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Convert to original coordinates (3x upscale + crop offset)
        int cam_x, cam_y, cam_w, cam_h;
        cv_scale_rect_to_cam(best_x, best_y, best_w, best_h, &cam_x, &cam_y, &cam_w, &cam_h);
        result->found = 1;
        result->x = cam_x;
        result->y = cam_y;
        result->w = cam_w;
        result->h = cam_h;
        result->score = best_score;
        result->detected_frame = ctx->frames_processed;
        ctx->faces_detected_total++;
        
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

void cv_process_frame(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *nv21, int face_every_n, MotionResult *motion_out, FaceResult *face_out) {
    
    if (!ctx || !nv21) return;

    // Downscale NV21 -> 160x120 grayscale
    cv_nv21_to_gray(nv21, ctx->gray);

    // Motion detection
    int motion = 0;
    if (motion_out) {
        motion = cv_detect_motion(ctx, ctx->gray, motion_out);
    }

    // Face detection
    //   - always if motion is detected
    //   - every N frames if face_every_n > 0
    //   - never if face_every_n == 0 and there's no motion
    if (face_out) {
        int do_face = motion;
        // Only do periodic face detection after first frame
        if (!do_face && face_every_n > 0 && ctx->frames_processed > 0)
            do_face = (ctx->frames_processed % face_every_n == 0);

        if (do_face && ctx->cascade_loaded) {
            cv_build_integral(ctx, ctx->gray);
            cv_detect_face(ctx, face_out);
        } else {
            memset(face_out, 0, sizeof(FaceResult));
        }
    }

    ctx->frames_processed++;
}

void cv_scale_rect_to_cam(int cv_x, int cv_y, int cv_w, int cv_h, int *cam_x, int *cam_y, int *cam_w, int *cam_h) {
   
    const int y_offset = (CAM_H - CV_H * 3) / 2;
    if (cam_x) *cam_x = cv_x * 3;
    if (cam_y) *cam_y = cv_y * 3 + y_offset;
    if (cam_w) *cam_w = cv_w * 3;
    if (cam_h) *cam_h = cv_h * 3;

}
```

`Lelouch/src/cv_lite.h`:

```h
#ifndef CV_LITE_H
#define CV_LITE_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define CV_W   160   // width after downscale (480/3)
#define CV_H   120   // height after downscale (640/(3*~1.78))

// Original camera dimensions
#define CAM_W  480
#define CAM_H  640

// Motion detection result
typedef struct {
    int  active;          // 1 = motion detected
    int  level;           // 0-255: average difference intensity per pixel
    int  hotspot_x;       // center of the block with most movement (original coords)
    int  hotspot_y;
    int  frame_count;     // frames processed since start
} MotionResult;

// Face detection result
typedef struct {
    int  found;           // 1 = face detected
    int  x, y, w, h;      // bounding box in ORIGINAL coordinates (pre-upscale)
    int  score;           // cascade score (higher is more confident)
    int  scan_ms;         // scan time in ms (diagnostic)
    int  detected_frame;  // frame number when detected (for expiration)
    int  windows_tested;  // number of windows scanned (diagnostic)
} FaceResult;

// Main context (allocated statically - zero malloc at runtime)
typedef struct {
    // Work buffers - allocated once, reused every time
    uint8_t  gray[CV_W * CV_H];        // current frame (downscaled Y)
    uint8_t  prev[CV_W * CV_H];        // previous frame (for motion diff)
    int32_t  integral[CV_W * CV_H];    // integral image (Haar features)
    int32_t  integral_sq[CV_W * CV_H]; // squared integral image (variance normalization)

    // Motion state
    int      motion_threshold;         // min average diff to trigger (default: 12)
    int      motion_cooldown;          // silence frames after trigger
    int      motion_cooldown_counter;

    // Face detection cascade
    void    *cascade;                  // pointer to loaded cascade data
    int      cascade_loaded;           // 1 if cascade loaded successfully

    // Stats
    int      frames_processed;
    int      faces_detected_total;
    int      motion_events_total;
} CvContext;

int cv_init(CvContext *ctx, const char *cascade_path);
void cv_destroy(CvContext *ctx);
void cv_nv21_to_gray(const uint8_t *nv21, uint8_t *out);
int cv_detect_motion(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *gray, MotionResult *result);
void cv_build_integral(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *gray);
int cv_detect_face(CvContext *ctx, FaceResult *result);
void cv_process_frame(CvContext *ctx, const uint8_t *nv21, int face_every_n, MotionResult *motion_out, FaceResult *face_out);
void cv_scale_rect_to_cam(int cv_x, int cv_y, int cv_w, int cv_h, int *cam_x, int *cam_y, int *cam_w, int *cam_h);
void *cv_cascade_load(const char *path);
void cv_cascade_free(void *cascade);

#endif
```

`Lelouch/src/debug_log.cc`:

```cc
#include "debug_log.h"
#include "ui.h" // for WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/reboot.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <pthread.h>

#define LOG_BUF_SIZE      (512 * 1024)
#define LOG_LINE_HEIGHT   16
static char            g_log_buffer[LOG_BUF_SIZE];
static int             g_log_len = 0;
static pthread_mutex_t g_log_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static int             g_log_pipe[2];
static pthread_t       g_log_reader_tid;

static void *log_reader_thread(void *arg) {
    char buf[1024]; struct pollfd fds;
    fds.fd = g_log_pipe[0]; fds.events = POLLIN;
    while (1) {
        int r = poll(&fds, 1, 100);
        if (r > 0 && (fds.revents & POLLIN)) {
            ssize_t n = read(g_log_pipe[0], buf, sizeof(buf)-1);
            if (n > 0) {
                buf[n] = '\0';
                pthread_mutex_lock(&g_log_mutex);
                if (g_log_len + n < LOG_BUF_SIZE - 1) {
                    memcpy(g_log_buffer + g_log_len, buf, n); g_log_len += n;
                } else {
                    int keep = LOG_BUF_SIZE / 2;
                    memmove(g_log_buffer, g_log_buffer + (g_log_len - keep), keep);
                    g_log_len = keep;
                    if (g_log_len + n < LOG_BUF_SIZE - 1) { memcpy(g_log_buffer + g_log_len, buf, n); g_log_len += n; }
                }
                g_log_buffer[g_log_len] = '\0';
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_log_mutex);
            } else if (n == 0) break;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

void init_log_capture() {
    pipe(g_log_pipe); dup2(g_log_pipe[1], STDERR_FILENO);
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0); close(g_log_pipe[1]);
    pthread_mutex_init(&g_log_mutex, NULL);
    pthread_create(&g_log_reader_tid, NULL, log_reader_thread, NULL);
    pthread_detach(g_log_reader_tid);
    dup2(STDERR_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO);
}

static void trigger_system_reboot() {
    sync(); 
    sync(); 
    reboot(RB_AUTOBOOT);
}

static int LogWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    HDC hdc; static int scroll_y = 0, ok_count = 0;
    switch (message) {
    case MSG_CREATE: SetTimer(hWnd, 200, 200); return 0;
    case MSG_TIMER:  InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE); return 0;
    case MSG_KEYDOWN:
        if (wParam == 0x80) { 
          scroll_y -= LOG_LINE_HEIGHT; 
          if (scroll_y<0) scroll_y=0; 
        }
        else if (wParam == 0x81) { 
          scroll_y += LOG_LINE_HEIGHT;
        }
        else if (wParam == 0x82) { 
          ok_count++; 
          if (ok_count>=5) trigger_system_reboot(); 
        }
        else ok_count = 0;
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE); 
        UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE); 
        return 0;
    case MSG_PAINT: {
        hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);
        SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN,5,5,5));
        FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_log_mutex);
        SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN,0,255,0));
        RECT rc = {0, -scroll_y, WINDOW_WIDTH, -scroll_y+WINDOW_HEIGHT};
        DrawText(hdc, g_log_buffer, g_log_len, &rc, DT_LEFT|DT_TOP|DT_EXPANDTABS);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_log_mutex);
        if (ok_count > 0) {
            char h[32]; snprintf(h,sizeof(h),"REBOOT:%d/5",ok_count);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN,255,0,0));
            TextOut(hdc, 5, 5, h);
        }
        EndPaint(hWnd, hdc); return 0;
    }
    case MSG_CLOSE:
        KillTimer(hWnd, 200); DestroyMainWindow(hWnd); PostQuitMessage(hWnd); return 0;
    }
    
    return DefaultMainWinProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void RunLogScene() {
    MSG Msg; MAINWINCREATE C; 
    HWND w;
    memset(&C,0,sizeof(C));
    C.dwStyle=WS_VISIBLE|WS_ABSSCRPOS; 
    C.dwExStyle=0x1000;
    C.spCaption="Debug Log"; 
    C.MainWindowProc=LogWinProc;
    C.rx=WINDOW_WIDTH; 
    C.by=WINDOW_HEIGHT;
    C.iBkColor=RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN,5,5,5); 
    C.hHosting=HWND_DESKTOP;
    w = CreateMainWindowEx(&C,0,0,0,0);
    
    if (w==HWND_INVALID) return;
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    
    while (GetMessage(&Msg,w)) { 
      TranslateMessage(&Msg);
      DispatchMessage(&Msg); 
    }
    
    MainWindowThreadCleanup(w);
}
```

`Lelouch/src/framebuffer.cc`:

```cc
#include "framebuffer.h"

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/fb.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>

void clear_framebuffer() {

  int fd = open("/dev/graphics/fb0", O_RDWR);
  if (fd >= 0) {

    struct fb_var_screeninfo vinfo;
    struct fb_fix_screeninfo finfo;

    if (ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO, &vinfo) == 0 &&
        ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_FSCREENINFO, &finfo) == 0) {

      long screensize = vinfo.yres_virtual * finfo.line_length;
      unsigned char *fbp = reinterpret_cast<unsigned char *>(
          mmap(NULL, screensize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0));
      if (fbp != MAP_FAILED) {

        memset(fbp, 0, screensize);
        munmap(fbp, screensize);
      }
    }

    close(fd);
  }
}
```

`Lelouch/src/hotspot_status.cc`:

```cc
#include "hotspot_status.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

void update_hotspot_status(char *status_buffer, int buffer_size, int state,
                           const char *ssid, int error_code) {
  if (!status_buffer || buffer_size < 1) {
    return;
  }

  switch (state) {
  case HOTSPOT_STATE_OFF: // 0 = off
    snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: --");
    break;

  case HOTSPOT_STATE_STARTING: // 1 = starting
    snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: starting...");
    break;

  case HOTSPOT_STATE_UP: // 2 = up
    if (ssid && ssid[0] != '\0') {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: %s", ssid);
    } else {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: ?log");
    }
    break;

  case HOTSPOT_STATE_ERROR: // 3 = error
    if (error_code == HOTSPOT_ERROR_OOM) {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: OOM");
    } else if (error_code == -10) {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: LIB ERR");
    } else if (error_code == -11) {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: SYM ERR");
    } else if (error_code == -12) {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: DRV ERR");
    } else {
      snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: ERR %d", error_code);
    }
    break;

  default:
    snprintf(status_buffer, buffer_size, "AP: --");
    break;
  }
}
```

```h
#ifndef HOTSPOT_STATUS_H

#endif

// Hotspot state values
#define HOTSPOT_STATE_OFF 0
#define HOTSPOT_STATE_STARTING 1
#define HOTSPOT_STATE_UP 2
#define HOTSPOT_STATE_ERROR 3

// Error codes
#define HOTSPOT_ERROR_OOM -1  // Out of memory
#define HOTSPOT_ERROR_LIB -10 // Library load error (dlopen failed)
#define HOTSPOT_ERROR_SYM -11 // Symbol resolution error (dlsym failed)
#define HOTSPOT_ERROR_DRV -12 // Driver load error (wlan0 missing)
#define HOTSPOT_ERROR_ACT -13 // Activation verification failed

/**
 * Update hotspot status string based on state and SSID
 */
void update_hotspot_status(char *status_buffer, int buffer_size, int state,
                           const char *ssid, int error_code);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif // HOTSPOT_STATUS_H
```

`Lelouch/src/keyboard_scene.cc`:

```cc
#include "keyboard_scene.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static int s_kb_result = 0;
static const char* s_kb_prompt = NULL;
static char* s_kb_buffer = NULL;
static int s_kb_buffer_size = 0;
static int s_kb_cursor = 0;

static const char* s_charset = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 -_.*:/>^";
static int s_charset_idx = 0;
static int s_charset_len = 0;

static bool s_kb_running = false;
static int s_ignore_input_ticks = 0;

static void KbInitParam(const char* prompt, char* buffer, int buf_size) {

    s_kb_prompt = prompt;
    s_kb_buffer = buffer;
    s_kb_buffer_size = buf_size;
    
    // Hard reset buffer and cursor to ensure pure state
    s_kb_cursor = 0;
    if (s_kb_buffer && s_kb_buffer_size > 0)
        memset(s_kb_buffer, 0, s_kb_buffer_size);
    
    s_charset_len = strlen(s_charset);
    s_charset_idx = 0; // Default to 'a'
    s_kb_result = 0;
    
    s_kb_running = true;
    s_ignore_input_ticks = 2; // Keep a small ignore state if needed

}

static int KeyboardWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

    HDC hdc;
    
    switch (message) {

        case MSG_CREATE:
            SetTimer(hWnd, 400, 50); // Still need a timer just to decay the ignore state
            return 0;

        case MSG_TIMER:

            if (s_ignore_input_ticks > 0)
                s_ignore_input_ticks--;

            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYDOWN:
            if (s_ignore_input_ticks > 0) return 0;
            
            if (wParam == 0x80) // Up - Previous char
                s_charset_idx = (s_charset_idx - 1 + s_charset_len) % s_charset_len;
            else if (wParam == 0x81) // Down - Next char
                s_charset_idx = (s_charset_idx + 1) % s_charset_len;
            
            InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
            UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYUP:
            if (s_ignore_input_ticks > 0) return 0;

            if (wParam == 130 || wParam == 0x82) { // OK tap

                char c = s_charset[s_charset_idx];
                if (c == '>') {

                    s_kb_result = 1; // CONFIRM
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                } else if (c == '^') {

                    s_kb_result = 0; // CANCEL
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                } else {

                    // Tap -> Add current character
                    if (s_kb_cursor < s_kb_buffer_size - 1) {

                        s_kb_buffer[s_kb_cursor++] = c;
                        s_kb_buffer[s_kb_cursor] = '\0';
                        s_charset_idx = 0; // Reset to 'a'

                    }

                }

            } else if (wParam == 131 || wParam == 0x83) { // Power tap -> Backspace

                if (s_kb_cursor > 0) {

                    s_kb_cursor--;
                    s_kb_buffer[s_kb_cursor] = '\0';

                }

            }

            InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
            UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            return 0;

        case MSG_PAINT: {

            hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);

            // Draw dark background
            gal_pixel bg = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 20, 20, 30);
            SetBrushColor(hdc, bg);
            FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);

            SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            
            // Draw Prompt
            if (s_kb_prompt)
                TextOut(hdc, 10, 20, s_kb_prompt);

            // Draw Typed Buffer
            char disp_buf[256];
            snprintf(disp_buf, sizeof(disp_buf), "> %s_", s_kb_buffer);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 100, 255, 100)); // Greenish
            // Word wrap drawing for buffer? Assuming it fits in some lines
            TextOut(hdc, 10, 50, disp_buf);

            // Draw Character Selector
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            int sel_x = WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 20;
            int sel_y = 100;
            
            // Draw a box around current char
            SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 50, 50, 80));
            FillBox(hdc, sel_x - 10, sel_y - 5, 40, 25);
            
            // Draw previous char above
            if (s_charset_idx > 0) {

                char prev_c[2] = { s_charset[s_charset_idx-1], 0 };
                SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 100, 100, 100));
                TextOut(hdc, sel_x, sel_y - 25, prev_c);

            } else {

                char prev_c[2] = { s_charset[s_charset_len-1], 0 };
                SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 100, 100, 100));
                TextOut(hdc, sel_x, sel_y - 25, prev_c);

            }

            // Current Char
            char curr_c[2] = { s_charset[s_charset_idx], 0 };
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            TextOut(hdc, sel_x, sel_y, curr_c);

            // Next Char below
            if (s_charset_idx < s_charset_len - 1) {

                char next_c[2] = { s_charset[s_charset_idx+1], 0 };
                SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 100, 100, 100));
                TextOut(hdc, sel_x, sel_y + 25, next_c);

            } else {

                char next_c[2] = { s_charset[0], 0 };
                SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 100, 100, 100));
                TextOut(hdc, sel_x, sel_y + 25, next_c);

            }

            // Draw Hints
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 150, 150, 150));
            TextOut(hdc, 10, 180, "UP/DN: Change | OK: Select");
            TextOut(hdc, 10, 195, "> : FINISH (Next/Connect)");
            TextOut(hdc, 10, 210, "^ : CANCEL | PWR: Backspace");

            EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);

            return 0;
        }

        case MSG_CLOSE:
            s_kb_running = false;
            KillTimer(hWnd, 400);
            DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
            // Kew from the future PLEASE REMEMBER TO DO NOT POST QUIT MESSAGE TO PREVENT THREAD FREEZE
            return 0;

    }

    return DefaultMainWinProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

int RunKeyboardScene(const char* prompt, char* output_buffer, int buffer_size) {

    MSG Msg;
    MAINWINCREATE C; 
    HWND w;
    
    KbInitParam(prompt, output_buffer, buffer_size);

    memset(&C, 0, sizeof(C));
    C.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS; 
    C.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
    C.spCaption = "Keyboard"; 
    C.MainWindowProc = KeyboardWinProc;
    C.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH; 
    C.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;
    C.iBkColor = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 20, 20, 30); 
    C.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;
    w = CreateMainWindowEx(&C, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    
    if (w == HWND_INVALID) return 0;
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    
    while (s_kb_running && GetMessage(&Msg, w)) { 
        TranslateMessage(&Msg);
        DispatchMessage(&Msg); 
    }
    
    return s_kb_result;
}
```

```cc
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <cutils/properties.h>

#include <minigui/common.h>
#include <minigui/gdi.h>
#include <minigui/minigui.h>
#include <minigui/window.h>

#include "binder.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "ui.h"

#include "wifi_sta.h"
#include "debug_log.h"
#include "framebuffer.h"

// UI state shared with ui.cc
static HWND hMainWnd;
int battery_level = 0;

static int main_app(int argc, const char *argv[]) {

  MSG Msg;
  MAINWINCREATE CreateInfo;
  gal_pixel pixel;
  RGB rgb;

  fprintf(stderr, "Starting Lelouch GUI...\n");

  // Binder Stuff
  init_binder();

  // Window creation
  memset(&CreateInfo, 0, sizeof(MAINWINCREATE));
  CreateInfo.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS;
  CreateInfo.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
  CreateInfo.spCaption = "Lelouch";
  CreateInfo.hMenu = 0;
  CreateInfo.hCursor = GetSystemCursor(0);
  CreateInfo.hIcon = 0;
  CreateInfo.MainWindowProc = reinterpret_cast<WNDPROC>(LelouchMainWinProc);
  CreateInfo.lx = 0;
  CreateInfo.ty = 0;
  CreateInfo.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH;
  CreateInfo.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;

  rgb.r = 0;
  rgb.g = 0;
  rgb.b = 0;
  RGBA2Pixels(HDC_SCREEN, &rgb, &pixel, 1);
  CreateInfo.iBkColor = pixel;
  CreateInfo.dwAddData = 0;
  CreateInfo.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;

  // Wifi Stuff
  //pthread_t hs_tid;
  //pthread_create(&hs_tid, NULL, wifi_hotspot_thread, NULL);
  //pthread_detach(hs_tid);
  //fprintf(stderr, "[WIFI] Hotspot thread started\n");

  // Wifi STA
  //pthread_t sta_tid;
  //if (pthread_create(&sta_tid, NULL, wifi_sta_thread, NULL) == 0) {
  //  pthread_detach(sta_tid);
  //}

  hMainWnd = CreateMainWindowEx(&CreateInfo, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (hMainWnd == HWND_INVALID) {

    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] Window creation failed\n");

    return -1;
  }

  ShowWindow(hMainWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
  SetFocus(hMainWnd);

  // Camera Stuff
  pthread_t camera_tid;
  pthread_create(&camera_tid, NULL, camera_thread, NULL);
  pthread_detach(camera_tid);

  // Message loop
  while (GetMessage(&Msg, hMainWnd)) {

    TranslateMessage(&Msg);
    DispatchMessage(&Msg);
  }

  MainWindowThreadCleanup(hMainWnd);

  return 0;
}

extern "C" int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {

  init_log_capture();
  clear_framebuffer();

  if (InitGUI(argc, argv)) {

    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] Failed to initialize MiniGUI\n");

    return 1;
  }

  int ret = main_app(argc, argv);

  TerminateGUI(0);

  return ret;
}
```

`Lelouch/src/menu_scene.cc`:

```cc
#include "menu_scene.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "wifi_hotspot.h"
#include "wifi_sta.h"
#include "system_info.h"
#include "browser_scene.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MENU_ITEMS_COUNT 5
static const char* menu_items[MENU_ITEMS_COUNT] = {

    "CAM", // Action Camera
    "STA", // WiFi STA
    "AP",  // WiFi Hotspot
    "WEB",  // Web Browser
    "TEST" // Feature testing

};

static int selected_index = 0;
static int scroll_offset = 0;

#define MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS 2
static gal_pixel gradient_lut[WINDOW_HEIGHT];
static bool lut_initialized = false;

static bool menu_power_pressed = false;
static int menu_power_hold_ticks = 0;
static bool menu_is_shutting_down = false;

extern char time_str[32];
extern int battery_level;

static void FillRoundRect(HDC hdc, int x, int y, int w, int h, int r) {

    if (r <= 0) {

        FillBox(hdc, x, y, w, h);
        
        return;
    }

    // 4 corners
    FillCircle(hdc, x + r, y + r, r);
    FillCircle(hdc, x + w - r - 1, y + r, r);
    FillCircle(hdc, x + r, y + h - r - 1, r);
    FillCircle(hdc, x + w - r - 1, y + h - r - 1, r);
    
    // Cross
    FillBox(hdc, x + r, y, w - 2 * r, h);
    FillBox(hdc, x, y + r, r, h - 2 * r);
    FillBox(hdc, x + w - r, y + r, r, h - 2 * r);

}

static void PrecomputeGradient() {

    if (lut_initialized) return;

    for (int y = 0; y < WINDOW_HEIGHT; y++) {

        float t = (float)y / WINDOW_HEIGHT;
        int r = (int)(25 + t * 50);   // Dark blue to purple
        int g = (int)(15 + t * 10);
        int b = (int)(80 + t * 100);
        gradient_lut[y] = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, r, g, b);

    }

    lut_initialized = true;

}

static int MenuWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

    HDC hdc;
    switch (message) {

        case MSG_CREATE:
            PrecomputeGradient();
            SetTimer(hWnd, 300, 50); // 500ms intervals, id 300
            return 0;

        case MSG_TIMER:
            static int counter = 0;
            if (++counter >= 20) {

                update_time();
                battery_level = read_battery_level();
                counter = 0;
                InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE);

            }

            if (menu_is_shutting_down) {

                static int shutdown_wait_ticks = 0;
                shutdown_wait_ticks++;
                if (shutdown_wait_ticks >= 4) { // 2 seconds

                    sync();
                    sync();
                    system("reboot -p &"); // Power off

                }

                return 0;
            }
            if (menu_power_pressed) {

                menu_power_hold_ticks++;
                if (menu_power_hold_ticks >= 2) { // 1 second hold

                    menu_is_shutting_down = true;
                    system("tinyplay /system/res/others/shutdown.wav &"); 
                    InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
                    UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

                }

            }

            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYDOWN:

            if (wParam == 0x80) { // Up

                selected_index = (selected_index - 1 + MENU_ITEMS_COUNT) % MENU_ITEMS_COUNT;
                {
                    int sel_row = selected_index / 2;
                    if (sel_row < scroll_offset)
                        scroll_offset = sel_row;
                    else if (sel_row >= scroll_offset + MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)
                        scroll_offset = sel_row - MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS + 1;
                }

            } else if (wParam == 0x81) { // Down

                selected_index = (selected_index + 1) % MENU_ITEMS_COUNT;
                {
                    int sel_row = selected_index / 2;
                    if (sel_row < scroll_offset)
                        scroll_offset = sel_row;
                    else if (sel_row >= scroll_offset + MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)
                        scroll_offset = sel_row - MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS + 1;
                }

            } else if (wParam == 0x82) { // OK
               
                if (selected_index == 0) { // Action Camera

                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0); // Close menu

                } else if (selected_index == 1) { // WiFi STA
                    
                    fprintf(stderr, "[MENU] Starting WiFi STA...\n");
                    pthread_t tid;
                    pthread_create(&tid, NULL, wifi_sta_thread, NULL);
                    pthread_detach(tid);
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                } else if (selected_index == 2) { // WiFi AP

                    fprintf(stderr, "[MENU] Starting WiFi Hotspot...\n");
                    pthread_t tid;
                    pthread_create(&tid, NULL, wifi_hotspot_thread, NULL);
                    pthread_detach(tid);
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0);

                } else if (selected_index == 3) { // WebBrowser

                    fprintf(stderr, "[MENU] WebBrowser selected\n");
                    RunBrowserScene();

                }
            } else if (wParam == 0x83) { // Power

                if (!menu_power_pressed) {

                    menu_power_pressed = true;
                    menu_power_hold_ticks = 0;

                }

            }

            InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
            UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);

            return 0;

        case MSG_KEYUP:
            if (wParam == 131) { // Power Button

                if (menu_power_pressed && menu_power_hold_ticks < 2) {

                    KillTimer(hWnd, 300);
                    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_CLOSE, 0, 0); // Short tap closes menu

                }

                menu_power_pressed = false;
                menu_power_hold_ticks = 0;

            }

            return 0;

        case MSG_PAINT: {

            hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);

            if (menu_is_shutting_down) {

                // Use a non-colliding off-black to hide the camera transparent layer completely
                gal_pixel off_black = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 5, 5, 5);
                gal_pixel red = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 50, 50);
                SetBrushColor(hdc, off_black);
                FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);
                SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
                SetTextColor(hdc, red);
                TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 60, WINDOW_HEIGHT / 2, "Shutting down...");
                EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);

                return 0;
            }

            // Draw Gradient Background
            for (int y = 0; y < WINDOW_HEIGHT; y++) {

                SetBrushColor(hdc, gradient_lut[y]);
                FillBox(hdc, 0, y, WINDOW_WIDTH, 1);

            }

            // Draw Top bar
            SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255));
            TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 20, 2, "Menu");
            
            TextOut(hdc, 5, 2, time_str);
            char batt[16] = {0};
            snprintf(batt, sizeof(batt), "%d%%", battery_level);
            TextOut(hdc, 280, 2, batt);

            // Draw bottom hint
            SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 150, 150, 150));
            TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 40, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 20, "v ^ : Nav  OK : Sel");

            // Scroll indicators
            int total_rows = (MENU_ITEMS_COUNT + 1) / 2;
            if (scroll_offset > 0)
                TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 4, 18, "^");
            if (scroll_offset + MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS < total_rows)
                TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 4, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 32, "v");

            // Draw grid settings
            {
                int item_w = 80;
                int item_h = 60;
                int base_x = (WINDOW_WIDTH - (item_w * 2 + 20)) / 2;
                int base_y = 60;
                int gap_x = 20;
                int gap_y = 20;
                int corner_r = 10;

                for (int i = 0; i < MENU_ITEMS_COUNT; i++) {

                    int col = i % 2;
                    int row = i / 2;

                    // skip rows outside the visible window
                    if (row < scroll_offset || row >= scroll_offset + MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)
                        continue;

                    int x = base_x + col * (item_w + gap_x);
                    int y = base_y + (row - scroll_offset) * (item_h + gap_y);

                    if (i == selected_index) {

                        SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255)); // Highlight White
                        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 0, 0, 0)); // Black text
                    
                    } else {
                    
                        SetBrushColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 60, 60, 80)); // Unselected Grey-blue
                        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255)); // White text
                    
                    }

                    FillRoundRect(hdc, x, y, item_w, item_h, corner_r);
                    
                    int text_len = strlen(menu_items[i]);
                    int char_w = 8; // Assuming char width is roughly 8px
                    int txt_x = x + (item_w - text_len * char_w) / 2;
                    int txt_y = y + (item_h - 16) / 2; // Assuming font height 16px
                    TextOut(hdc, txt_x, txt_y, menu_items[i]);

                }
            }

            EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);

            return 0;
        }

        case MSG_CLOSE:

            KillTimer(hWnd, 300);
            DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
            PostQuitMessage(hWnd);

            return 0;
    }

    return DefaultMainWinProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void RunMenuScene() {

    MSG Msg;
    MAINWINCREATE C; 
    HWND w;
    memset(&C, 0, sizeof(C));
    C.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS; 
    C.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
    C.spCaption = "Menu"; 
    C.MainWindowProc = MenuWinProc;
    C.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH; 
    C.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;
    C.iBkColor = PIXEL_transparent; 
    C.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;
    w = CreateMainWindowEx(&C, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    
    if (w == HWND_INVALID) return;
    ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    
    while (GetMessage(&Msg, w)) { 

        TranslateMessage(&Msg);
        DispatchMessage(&Msg); 

    }
    
    MainWindowThreadCleanup(w);
}
```

`Lelouch/src/system_info.cc`:

```cc
#include "system_info.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <time.h>

// Shared with the UI layer via extern declarations
char time_str[32] = "0000-00-00 00:00";

int read_battery_level() {

  FILE *fp = fopen("/sys/class/power_supply/battery/capacity", "r");
  int level = 0;
  if (fp) {

    if (fscanf(fp, "%d", &level) != 1)
      level = 0;

    fclose(fp);
  }

  return level;
}

void update_time() {

  time_t now = time(NULL);
  struct tm *t = localtime(&now);
  snprintf(time_str, sizeof(time_str), "%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d",
           t->tm_year + 1900, t->tm_mon + 1, t->tm_mday, t->tm_hour, t->tm_min);
}
```

```h
#pragma once

/**
 * system_info.h
 *
 * System information helpers.
 * Reads hardware telemetry such as battery capacity and the current wall-clock
 * time, formatting them into strings ready for the UI layer.
 */

/** Returns the current battery percentage (0-100) or 0 on failure. */
int read_battery_level();

/**
 * Refreshes the global time_str buffer with the current
 * local date/time in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" format.
 */
void update_time();
```

`Lelouch/src/ui.cc`:

```cc
#include "ui.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "system_info.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "debug_log.h"
#include "menu_scene.h"
#include "framebuffer.h"
#include <sys/reboot.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MSG_USER_OPEN_MENU (MSG_USER + 100)

// Shared time/battery state (defined in system_info.cc)
extern char time_str[32];
extern int battery_level;
extern char g_hotspot_status[64];
extern int g_hotspot_state;

static void show_shutdown_logo() {
  int fd_logo = open("/dev/block/mtdblock5", O_RDONLY);
  if (fd_logo >= 0) {
    char* buf = reinterpret_cast<char*>(malloc(0x80000));
    if (buf) {
      read(fd_logo, buf, 0x80000);
      free(buf);
    }
  }
  if (fd_logo >= 0) close(fd_logo);
}

int LelouchMainWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

  HDC hdc; 
  static int counter=0, ok_press_count=0;
  static bool power_pressed = false;
  static int power_hold_ticks = 0;
  static int last_key_pressed = 0;
  static bool is_shutting_down = false;
  static int shutdown_wait_ticks = 0;
  
  static bool down_pressed = false;
  static int menu_trigger_count = 0;

  switch (message) {

  case MSG_CREATE:
    update_time();
    battery_level = read_battery_level();
    SetTimer(hWnd, 100, 50);
    PostMessage(hWnd, MSG_USER_OPEN_MENU, 0, 0);
    return 0;

  case MSG_USER_OPEN_MENU:
    RunMenuScene();
    clear_framebuffer();
    ShowWindow(hWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
    UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
    return 0;

  case MSG_TIMER:
    if (is_shutting_down) {
      shutdown_wait_ticks++;
      if (shutdown_wait_ticks >= 4) { // 2 seconds wait before hardware cut
        sync();
        sync();
        reboot(RB_POWER_OFF);
      }
      return 0; // Skip UI updates during shutdown
    }

    counter++;
    if (counter >= 20) {
      update_time();
      battery_level = read_battery_level();
      counter = 0;
    }
    if (power_pressed) {
      power_hold_ticks++;
      if (power_hold_ticks >= 2) { // 1 second hold
        is_shutting_down = true;
        system("tinyplay /system/res/others/shutdown.wav &"); // Shutdown sound..
        show_shutdown_logo();
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
      }
    }
    InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE);
    return 0;

  case MSG_PAINT: {
    hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);
    if (is_shutting_down) {
      gal_pixel off_black = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 5, 5, 5); // Non-transparent black
      gal_pixel red = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 0, 0);
      SetBrushColor(hdc, off_black);
      FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT);
      SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);
      SetTextColor(hdc, red);
      TextOut(hdc, WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 - 60, WINDOW_HEIGHT / 2, "Shutting down...");
      EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);
      return 0;
    }

    gal_pixel black = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 0, 0, 0);
    gal_pixel white = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 255);
    gal_pixel green = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 0, 255, 0);
    gal_pixel yellow = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 255, 0);
    gal_pixel cyan = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 0, 255, 255);
    gal_pixel red = RGB2Pixel(HDC_SCREEN, 255, 0, 0);

    SetBrushColor(hdc, black);

    // Status bars drawn in the MiniGUI framebuffer (overlay over HW layer)
    FillBox(hdc, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TOP_BAR_HEIGHT);
    FillBox(hdc, 0, WINDOW_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH,
            BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT);

    SetBkMode(hdc, BM_TRANSPARENT);

    // Top bar: date/time (left) and battery (right)
    SetTextColor(hdc, white);
    TextOut(hdc, 5, 2, time_str);

    char batt[16] = {0};
    snprintf(batt, sizeof(batt), "%d%%", battery_level);
    TextOut(hdc, 280, 2, batt);

    // Bottom bar: camera status (direct read with cast)
    SetTextColor(hdc, camera_init_done ? green : yellow);
    TextOut(hdc, 5, WINDOW_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT + 2, (const char*)camera_status);

    if (camera_init_done) {

      char info[32] = {0};
      snprintf(info, sizeof(info), "L:%d", mLayerId);
      SetTextColor(hdc, yellow);
      TextOut(hdc, 150, WINDOW_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT + 2, info);
    }

    gal_pixel ap_col = (g_hotspot_state == 2)   ? cyan
                       : (g_hotspot_state == 1) ? yellow
                       : (g_hotspot_state == 3) ? red
                                                : white;
    SetTextColor(hdc, ap_col);
    TextOut(hdc, 180, WINDOW_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT + 2, g_hotspot_status);

    if(ok_press_count>0){
    
      char h[16];
      snprintf(h,sizeof(h),"LOG:%d/5",ok_press_count);
      SetTextColor(hdc,yellow);
      TextOut(hdc,160,2,h);
    
    }

    /*
    if (last_key_pressed > 0) {
      char kc[32];
      snprintf(kc, sizeof(kc), "Key: %d (0x%X)", last_key_pressed, last_key_pressed);
      SetTextColor(hdc, yellow);
      TextOut(hdc, 5, 40, kc);
    }
    */

    EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);
    return 0;
  }

  case MSG_CLOSE:
    KillTimer(hWnd, 100);
    DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
    PostQuitMessage(hWnd);
    return 0;

  case MSG_KEYDOWN:
    last_key_pressed = wParam;
    if (wParam == 0x83) { // Power button (0x83)
      if (!power_pressed) {
        power_pressed = true;
        power_hold_ticks = 0;
      }
    } else if (wParam == 0x81) { // Down button
      // Using Down button as the menu trigger
      if (++menu_trigger_count >= 1) { // Single press for menu
        menu_trigger_count = 0;
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
        UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
        RunMenuScene();
        clear_framebuffer();
        ShowWindow(hWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
        UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
      }
    } else if (wParam == 0x82) { // OK button
      if (++ok_press_count >= 5) {
        ok_press_count = 0;
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
        UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
        RunLogScene();
        clear_framebuffer();
        ShowWindow(hWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
        UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
      }
    } else if (wParam != 0x80) {
      ok_press_count = 0;
      menu_trigger_count = 0;
    }
    InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
    UpdateWindow(hWnd, TRUE);
    return 0;
  case MSG_KEYUP:
    if (wParam == 131) {
      power_pressed = false;
      power_hold_ticks = 0;
      InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, TRUE);
    }
  case MSG_CHAR:
  case MSG_KEYLONGPRESS:
    return 0;

  default:
    return DefaultWindowProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
  }
}
```
