`Lelouch/src/wifi_hotspot.cc`:

```cc
#include "wifi_hotspot.h"

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cutils/properties.h>

#include "hotspot_status.h"

#include <hardware_legacy/wifi.h>
#include <hardware_legacy/wifi_api.h>
#include <hardware_legacy/softap.h>

// Wifi Hotspot Stuff
static void *g_wifi_hal_handle = NULL;
typedef int (*setWifiEnable_t)(int enable);
typedef int (*getWifiEnable_t)(int *status);
typedef int (*setSoftap_t)(char *ssid, char *password);
typedef int (*enableSoftAp_t)(int ret);
typedef int (*isSoftAPenabled_t)(void);
typedef int (*disableSoftAp_t)(void);

typedef void (*wifi_setCallBack_t)(void (*callback)(int, int, void *),
                                   void *cookie);

static setWifiEnable_t fn_setWifiEnable = NULL;
static getWifiEnable_t fn_getWifiEnable = NULL;
static setSoftap_t fn_setSoftap = NULL;
static enableSoftAp_t fn_enableSoftAp = NULL;
isSoftAPenabled_t fn_isSoftAPenabled = NULL;
disableSoftAp_t fn_disableSoftAp = NULL;
static wifi_setCallBack_t fn_wifi_setCallBack = NULL;

pthread_mutex_t g_softap_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

#define HOTSPOT_SSID "OlaMundo"
#define HOTSPOT_PASSWORD "OlaMundinhoo"
#define KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL 30

char g_hotspot_status[64] = "AP: --";

volatile int g_hotspot_state = 0;

static void update_hotspot_status_internal(int state, const char *ssid,
                                           int error_code);

static int enable_softap_safe(const char *ssid, const char *password) {
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_softap_mutex);

  // Check if already enabled
  if (fn_isSoftAPenabled && fn_isSoftAPenabled() == 1) {
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
    return 0;
  }

  // Disable WiFi STA if active
  if (fn_getWifiEnable && fn_setWifiEnable) {
    int wifi_status = 0;
    fn_getWifiEnable(&wifi_status);
    if (wifi_status == 1) {
      fn_setWifiEnable(0);
      sleep(1);
    }
  }

  // Configure and enable SoftAP
  int ret = 0;
  if (fn_setSoftap) {
    ret = fn_setSoftap(const_cast<char *>(ssid), const_cast<char *>(password));
    if (ret != 0) {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
      return ret;
    }
  }

  if (fn_enableSoftAp) {
    ret = fn_enableSoftAp(ret);
    if (ret != 0) {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
      return ret;
    }
  }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
  return 0;
}

static void update_hotspot_status_internal(int state, const char *ssid,
                                           int error_code) {
  update_hotspot_status(g_hotspot_status, sizeof(g_hotspot_status), state, ssid,
                        error_code);
}

static bool initialize_wifi() {
  g_wifi_hal_handle = dlopen("/system/lib/libhardware_legacy.so", RTLD_NOW);

  fn_wifi_setCallBack = reinterpret_cast<wifi_setCallBack_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "wifi_setCallBack"));
  fn_setWifiEnable = reinterpret_cast<setWifiEnable_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "setWifiEnable"));
  fn_getWifiEnable = reinterpret_cast<getWifiEnable_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "getWifiEnable"));
  fn_setSoftap =
      reinterpret_cast<setSoftap_t>(dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "setSoftap"));
  fn_enableSoftAp = reinterpret_cast<enableSoftAp_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "enableSoftAp"));
  fn_isSoftAPenabled = reinterpret_cast<isSoftAPenabled_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "isSoftAPenabled"));
  fn_disableSoftAp = reinterpret_cast<disableSoftAp_t>(
      dlsym(g_wifi_hal_handle, "disableSoftAp"));

  return g_wifi_hal_handle && fn_wifi_setCallBack && fn_setWifiEnable &&
         fn_getWifiEnable && fn_setSoftap && fn_enableSoftAp &&
         fn_isSoftAPenabled && fn_disableSoftAp;
}

void *wifi_hotspot_thread(void *arg) {
  int confirmed = 0;
  int ret = 0;
  int r = 0;
  char *ssid_buf = NULL;
  char *pwd_buf = NULL;

  if (!initialize_wifi()) {
    g_hotspot_state = 3;
    update_hotspot_status_internal(3, NULL, -12);
    return NULL;
  }

  fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] SSID='%s'  PWD='%s'\n", HOTSPOT_SSID,
          HOTSPOT_PASSWORD);

  if (!fn_setSoftap || !fn_enableSoftAp || !fn_isSoftAPenabled ||
      !fn_getWifiEnable || !fn_setWifiEnable) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] ERROR: WiFi HAL not fully initialized\n");
    fprintf(
        stderr,
        "[HotSpot] fn_setSoftap=%p fn_enableSoftAp=%p fn_isSoftAPenabled=%p\n",
        reinterpret_cast<void *>(fn_setSoftap),
        reinterpret_cast<void *>(fn_enableSoftAp),
        reinterpret_cast<void *>(fn_isSoftAPenabled));
    fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] fn_getWifiEnable=%p fn_setWifiEnable=%p\n",
            reinterpret_cast<void *>(fn_getWifiEnable),
            reinterpret_cast<void *>(fn_setWifiEnable));
    g_hotspot_state = 3;
    update_hotspot_status_internal(3, NULL, -10);
    return NULL;
  }

  system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_mac.ko 2>&1");
  system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_core.ko 2>&1");
  system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_wlan.ko 2>&1");
  sleep(1);

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_softap_mutex);

  confirmed = fn_isSoftAPenabled();

  if (confirmed == 1) {
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
    g_hotspot_state = 2;
    update_hotspot_status_internal(2, HOTSPOT_SSID, 0);
    goto keepalive;
  }

  if (fn_getWifiEnable && fn_setWifiEnable) {
    int wifi_status = 0;
    fn_getWifiEnable(&wifi_status);
    if (wifi_status == 1) {
      fn_setWifiEnable(0);
      sleep(1);
    }
  }

  ssid_buf = reinterpret_cast<char *>(malloc(0x80));
  pwd_buf = reinterpret_cast<char *>(malloc(0x80));

  if (!ssid_buf || !pwd_buf) {
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
    if (ssid_buf)
      free(ssid_buf);
    if (pwd_buf)
      free(pwd_buf);
    g_hotspot_state = 3;
    update_hotspot_status_internal(3, NULL, -11);
    return NULL;
  }

  memset(ssid_buf, 0, 0x80);
  memset(pwd_buf, 0, 0x80);
  strncpy(ssid_buf, HOTSPOT_SSID, 0x7F);
  strncpy(pwd_buf, HOTSPOT_PASSWORD, 0x7F);

  property_set("persist.sys.softap.ssid", ssid_buf);
  property_set("persist.sys.softap.pwd", pwd_buf);
  fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] $$mSoftApSsid is %s  : mSoftApPassword is %s$$\n",
          ssid_buf, pwd_buf);

  ret = fn_setSoftap(ssid_buf, pwd_buf);
  ret = fn_enableSoftAp(ret);

  free(ssid_buf);
  free(pwd_buf);

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);

  if (ret != 0) {
    g_hotspot_state = 3;
    update_hotspot_status_internal(3, NULL, ret);
    return NULL;
  }

  g_hotspot_state = 2;
  update_hotspot_status_internal(2, HOTSPOT_SSID, 0);

  sleep(3);

  confirmed = fn_isSoftAPenabled();

  if (confirmed != 1) {
    fprintf(stderr,
            "[HotSpot] WARNING: isSoftAPenabled returned %d (expected 1)\n",
            confirmed);
  }

keepalive:
  fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] Entering keepalive loop (checking every %ds)\n",
          KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL);

  while (1) {
    sleep(KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL);

    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_softap_mutex);
    int status = fn_isSoftAPenabled();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);

    if (g_hotspot_state == 2 && status != 1) {
      fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] AP went down (status=%d) — restarting...\n",
              status);

      r = enable_softap_safe(HOTSPOT_SSID, HOTSPOT_PASSWORD);
      if (r == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] AP restarted successfully\n");
        g_hotspot_state = 2;
        update_hotspot_status_internal(2, HOTSPOT_SSID, 0);
      } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HotSpot] AP restart failed: %d\n", r);
        g_hotspot_state = 3;
        update_hotspot_status_internal(3, NULL, r);
      }
    }
  }

  return NULL;
}

`Lelouch/src/wifi_sta.cc`:

```cc
#include "wifi_sta.h"
#include "wifi_hotspot.h"

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define WPA_SOCKET_PATH_1  "/data/misc/wifi/sockets/wlan0"
#define WPA_CONF_PATH      "/data/misc/wifi/wpa_supplicant.conf"

typedef struct {
    char ipaddr[32];
} network_config_t;

typedef enum {
    STA_STATE_INIT = 0,
    STA_STATE_MODULES_LOADED,
    STA_STATE_HAL_RESOLVED,
    STA_STATE_WIFI_ENABLED,
    STA_STATE_CONNECTED,
    STA_STATE_DHCP_OK,
    STA_STATE_HTTP_OK,
    STA_STATE_ERROR = -1
} sta_connection_state_t;

static sta_connection_state_t g_sta_state = STA_STATE_INIT;

static int socket_exists(const char *path) {
    struct ::stat st;
    if (::stat(path, &st) != 0) return 0;
    return S_ISSOCK(st.st_mode) ? 1 : 0;
}

static int g_wpa_ctrl_fd = -1;
static struct sockaddr_un g_wpa_ctrl_local;
static struct sockaddr_un g_wpa_ctrl_dest;

static int wpa_ctrl_open_direct(const char *ctrl_path) {
    char local_path[128];

    int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] socket() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    memset(&g_wpa_ctrl_local, 0, sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_local));
    g_wpa_ctrl_local.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    snprintf(local_path, sizeof(local_path),
             "/data/misc/wifi/sockets/wpa_ctrl_%d", (int)getpid());
    strncpy(g_wpa_ctrl_local.sun_path, local_path,
            sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_local.sun_path) - 1);

    unlink(local_path);

    if (bind(fd, reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr *>(&g_wpa_ctrl_local),
             sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_local)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] bind() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    memset(&g_wpa_ctrl_dest, 0, sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_dest));
    g_wpa_ctrl_dest.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    strncpy(g_wpa_ctrl_dest.sun_path, ctrl_path,
            sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_dest.sun_path) - 1);

    if (connect(fd, reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr *>(&g_wpa_ctrl_dest),
                sizeof(g_wpa_ctrl_dest)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] connect() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        unlink(local_path);
        return -1;
    }

    g_wpa_ctrl_fd = fd;
    return 0;
}

static void wpa_ctrl_close_direct(void) {
    if (g_wpa_ctrl_fd >= 0) {
        close(g_wpa_ctrl_fd);
        unlink(g_wpa_ctrl_local.sun_path);
        g_wpa_ctrl_fd = -1;
    }
}

static int wpa_ctrl_command_direct(const char *cmd, char *reply,
                                   size_t *reply_len) {
    struct timeval tv;
    fd_set rfds;

    if (g_wpa_ctrl_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] socket not connected\n");
        return -1;
    }

    int ret = static_cast<int>(send(g_wpa_ctrl_fd, cmd, strlen(cmd), 0));
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] send() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    FD_ZERO(&rfds);
    FD_SET(g_wpa_ctrl_fd, &rfds);
    tv.tv_sec  = 5;
    tv.tv_usec = 0;

    ret = select(g_wpa_ctrl_fd + 1, &rfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] select() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    if (ret == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] timeout waiting for response to '%s'\n", cmd);
        return -1;
    }

    ret = (int)recv(g_wpa_ctrl_fd, reply, *reply_len - 1, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_CTRL] recv() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    reply[ret] = '\0';
    *reply_len  = (size_t)ret;
    return 0;
}

static int wpa_connect_network_direct(const char *ssid, const char *password) {
    char reply[256];
    size_t reply_len;
    char cmd[512];

    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct("PING", reply, &reply_len) < 0 ||
        strncmp(reply, "PONG", 4) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_DIRECT] PING failed\n");
        return -1;
    }

    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct("ADD_NETWORK", reply, &reply_len) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_DIRECT] ADD_NETWORK failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    int network_id = atoi(reply);

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "SET_NETWORK %d ssid \"%s\"", network_id, ssid);
    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct(cmd, reply, &reply_len) < 0 ||
        strncmp(reply, "OK", 2) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_DIRECT] SET_NETWORK ssid failed\n");
        return -1;
    }

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "SET_NETWORK %d psk \"%s\"", network_id, password);
    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct(cmd, reply, &reply_len) < 0 ||
        strncmp(reply, "OK", 2) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_DIRECT] SET_NETWORK psk failed\n");
        return -1;
    }

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "SET_NETWORK %d key_mgmt WPA-PSK", network_id);
    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    wpa_ctrl_command_direct(cmd, reply, &reply_len);

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "SELECT_NETWORK %d", network_id);
    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    wpa_ctrl_command_direct(cmd, reply, &reply_len);

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "ENABLE_NETWORK %d", network_id);
    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct(cmd, reply, &reply_len) < 0 ||
        strncmp(reply, "OK", 2) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_DIRECT] ENABLE_NETWORK failed\n");
        return -1;
    }

    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    wpa_ctrl_command_direct("REASSOCIATE", reply, &reply_len);

    reply_len = sizeof(reply);
    wpa_ctrl_command_direct("SAVE_CONFIG", reply, &reply_len);

    return network_id;
}

static int wpa_check_status_direct(char *status_buf, size_t buf_size) {
    char reply[2048];
    size_t reply_len = sizeof(reply);

    if (wpa_ctrl_command_direct("STATUS", reply, &reply_len) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[WPA_STATUS] STATUS command failed\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (status_buf && buf_size > 0) {
        strncpy(status_buf, reply, buf_size - 1);
        status_buf[buf_size - 1] = '\0';
    }

    return (strstr(reply, "wpa_state=COMPLETED") != NULL) ? 1 : 0;
}

static int get_wlan0_ip(char *ip_buf, size_t buf_size) {
    char line[256];
    char *p = NULL;

    if (!ip_buf || buf_size < 16) return -1;
    memset(ip_buf, 0, buf_size);

    FILE *fp = popen("ifconfig wlan0 2>/dev/null", "r");
    if (!fp) return -1;

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {
        // Android format: "wlan0: ip 192.168.1.250 mask ..."
        p = strstr(line, " ip ");
        if (p) {
            p += 4;
            int i = 0;
            while (*p && *p != ' ' && *p != '\n' && i < (int)buf_size - 1)
                ip_buf[i++] = *p++;
            ip_buf[i] = '\0';
            if (strlen(ip_buf) > 6 && strcmp(ip_buf, "0.0.0.0") != 0) {
                pclose(fp);
                return 0;
            }
        }
        // Linux format: "inet addr:192.168.1.100"
        p = strstr(line, "inet addr:");
        if (p) {
            p += 10;
            int i = 0;
            while (*p && *p != ' ' && *p != '\n' && i < (int)buf_size - 1)
                ip_buf[i++] = *p++;
            ip_buf[i] = '\0';
            if (strlen(ip_buf) > 6 && strcmp(ip_buf, "0.0.0.0") != 0) {
                pclose(fp);
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }

    pclose(fp);
    return -1;
}

static int http_get_google(char *buffer, size_t buffer_size) {
    struct sockaddr_in server_addr;
    struct hostent *host = NULL;
    struct timeval timeout;
    int total_bytes = 0;
    int bytes_received = 0;
    char request[256];
    int status_code = 0;

    if (!buffer || !buffer_size) return -1;
    memset(buffer, 0, buffer_size);

    int sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    if (sockfd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HTTP] socket() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    timeout.tv_sec = 15;
    timeout.tv_usec = 0;
    setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout));
    setsockopt(sockfd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout));

    host = gethostbyname("www.google.com");
    if (!host) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HTTP] gethostbyname failed: h_errno=%d\n", h_errno);
        close(sockfd);
        return -1;
    }

    memset(&server_addr, 0, sizeof(server_addr));
    server_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    server_addr.sin_port   = htons(80);
    memcpy(&server_addr.sin_addr, host->h_addr_list[0], host->h_length);

    if (connect(sockfd, reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr *>(&server_addr),
                sizeof(server_addr)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HTTP] connect() failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(sockfd);
        return -1;
    }

    snprintf(request, sizeof(request),
             "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: www.google.com\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
    send(sockfd, request, strlen(request), 0);

    while (total_bytes < static_cast<int>(buffer_size) - 1) {
        bytes_received = static_cast<int>(recv(sockfd, buffer + total_bytes,
                                   buffer_size - total_bytes - 1, 0));
        if (bytes_received <= 0) break;
        total_bytes += bytes_received;
    }
    buffer[total_bytes] = '\0';

    char *rsp = strstr(buffer, "HTTP/");
    if (rsp) sscanf(rsp, "HTTP/%*d.%*d %d", &status_code);
    fprintf(stderr, "[HTTP] status=%d bytes=%d\n", status_code, total_bytes);

    close(sockfd);
    return total_bytes;
}

static int save_html_to_file(const char *content, size_t size) {
    const char *paths[] = {
        "/mnt/extsd/sta/logs/google_page.html",
        "/sdcard/google_page.html",
        "/data/google_page.html"
    };
    int idx = 0;
    if (!content || !size) return -1;
    FILE *fp = NULL;
    for (idx = 0; idx < 3; idx++) {
        fp = fopen(paths[idx], "w");
        if (fp) break;
    }
    if (!fp) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[HTML] No writable path available\n");
        return -1;
    }
    size_t w = fwrite(content, 1, size, fp);
    fclose(fp);
    fprintf(stderr, "[HTML] Saved %zu bytes to %s\n", w, paths[idx]);
    return (w == size) ? 0 : -1;
}

void *wifi_sta_thread(void *arg) {
    int ret = 0;
    int mutex_locked = 0;
    int socket_found = 0;
    int wpa_completed = 0;
    int got_ip = 0;
    network_config_t config;
    static char html_buffer[65536];
    int html_size = 0;
    FILE *fp = NULL;
    FILE *resolv_fp = NULL;
    const char *wpa_binary_path = NULL;
    struct ::stat st;
    int found = 0;
    char status_buf[2048];
    const char *sd_paths[] = {
        "/mnt/extsd/sta/wpa_supplicant",
        "/sdcard/wpa_supplicant",
        "/mnt/sdcard/wpa_supplicant",
        NULL
    };

    memset(&config, 0, sizeof(config));
    memset(html_buffer, 0, sizeof(html_buffer));

    const char* target_ssid = "NET_5G";
    const char* target_pass = "SUPERSECRETPASSWORD";

    if (arg != NULL) {
        wifi_sta_config_t* wc = (wifi_sta_config_t*)arg;
        target_ssid = wc->ssid;
        target_pass = wc->password;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Starting WiFi STA — target: '%s' (WPA2)\n", target_ssid);

    system("mkdir -p /mnt/extsd/sta/logs 2>/dev/null");

    // Load kernel modules
    g_sta_state = STA_STATE_INIT;
    system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_mac.ko 2>&1");
    system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_core.ko 2>&1");
    system("insmod /system/vendor/modules/xradio_wlan.ko 2>&1");
    sleep(3);
    g_sta_state = STA_STATE_MODULES_LOADED;

    // Bring up wlan0
    system("ifconfig wlan0 up 2>&1");
    sleep(2);

    // Acquire mutex and disable SoftAP if active
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_softap_mutex);
    mutex_locked = 1;

    if (fn_isSoftAPenabled && fn_isSoftAPenabled() == 1) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] SoftAP active — disabling\n");
        if (fn_disableSoftAp) {
            fn_disableSoftAp();
            sleep(2);
        }
    }

    // Locate wpa_supplicant binary on SD card
    for (int i = 0; sd_paths[i] != NULL; i++) {
        if (stat(sd_paths[i], &st) != 0) continue;

        if (st.st_size < 100000) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] wpa_supplicant too small (%ld bytes), skipping: %s\n",
                    (long)st.st_size, sd_paths[i]);
            continue;
        }

        // Re-stat to detect corruption between the two reads
        struct ::stat st2;
        if (stat(sd_paths[i], &st2) == 0 && st2.st_size < 100000) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] wpa_supplicant corrupted after re-check: %s\n",
                    sd_paths[i]);
            continue;
        }

        wpa_binary_path = sd_paths[i];
        found = 1;
        break;
    }

    if (!found) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: wpa_supplicant not found on SD card\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Place the binary at /mnt/extsd/sta/wpa_supplicant\n");
        system("mount > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/diag_mount.log 2>&1");
        system("find /mnt/ -name 'wpa*' 2>/dev/null > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/diag_find_wpa.log");
        system("cat /proc/mounts > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/diag_proc_mounts.log 2>&1");
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Validate binary size one final time before executing
    {
        struct ::stat st_final;
        if (stat(wpa_binary_path, &st_final) == 0 && st_final.st_size < 100000) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] CRITICAL: wpa_supplicant corrupted before exec\n");
            g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
            goto cleanup;
        }
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Using wpa_supplicant: %s\n", wpa_binary_path);

    // Create required directories
    system("mkdir -p /data/misc/wifi/sockets 2>/dev/null");
    system("chmod 777 /data/misc/wifi 2>/dev/null");
    system("chmod 777 /data/misc/wifi/sockets 2>/dev/null");

    // Create entropy.bin if absent
    if (access("/data/misc/wifi/entropy.bin", F_OK) != 0) {
        FILE *ef  = fopen("/dev/urandom", "r");
        FILE *ef2 = fopen("/data/misc/wifi/entropy.bin", "w");
        if (ef && ef2) {
            char buf[256];
            fread(buf, 1, 256, ef);
            fwrite(buf, 1, 256, ef2);
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] WARNING: failed to create entropy.bin\n");
        }
        if (ef)  fclose(ef);
        if (ef2) fclose(ef2);
    }

    // Create p2p_supplicant.conf
    fp = fopen("/data/misc/wifi/p2p_supplicant.conf", "w");
    if (fp) {
        fprintf(fp, "ctrl_interface=DIR=/data/misc/wifi/sockets GROUP=wifi\n");
        fprintf(fp, "update_config=1\n");
        fclose(fp);
        system("chmod 660 /data/misc/wifi/p2p_supplicant.conf 2>/dev/null");
    }

    // Create wpa_supplicant.conf with target network
    fp = fopen(WPA_CONF_PATH, "w");
    if (fp) {
        fprintf(fp, "ctrl_interface=DIR=/data/misc/wifi/sockets GROUP=wifi\n");
        fprintf(fp, "update_config=1\n\n");
        fprintf(fp, "network={\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    ssid=\"%s\"\n", target_ssid);
        fprintf(fp, "    psk=\"%s\"\n", target_pass);
        fprintf(fp, "    key_mgmt=WPA-PSK\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    proto=RSN WPA\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    pairwise=CCMP TKIP\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    group=CCMP TKIP\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    priority=1\n");
        fprintf(fp, "    scan_ssid=1\n");
        fprintf(fp, "}\n");
        fclose(fp);
        system("chmod 660 " WPA_CONF_PATH " 2>/dev/null");
    }

    // Kill any previous wpa_supplicant instance
    system("killall wpa_supplicant 2>/dev/null");
    sleep(1);
    system("rm -f /data/misc/wifi/sockets/wlan0 2>/dev/null");
    sleep(1);

    // Start wpa_supplicant
    {
        char wpa_cmd[512];
        snprintf(wpa_cmd, sizeof(wpa_cmd),
                 "%s -Dwext -iwlan0 "
                 "-c/data/misc/wifi/wpa_supplicant.conf "
                 "-O/data/misc/wifi/sockets "
                 "> /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/wpa_fg.log 2>&1 &",
                 wpa_binary_path);
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Launching: %s\n", wpa_cmd);
        system(wpa_cmd);
        sleep(2);
    }

    // Wait for control socket
    socket_found = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        if (socket_exists(WPA_SOCKET_PATH_1)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Control socket ready (%ds)\n", i + 1);
            socket_found = 1;
            break;
        }
        sleep(1);
    }

    if (!socket_found) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: control socket did not appear in 30s\n");

        // Retry with debug level to capture more diagnostics
        {
            char wpa_cmd[512];
            snprintf(wpa_cmd, sizeof(wpa_cmd),
                     "%s -dd -Dwext -iwlan0 "
                     "-c/data/misc/wifi/wpa_supplicant.conf "
                     "-O/data/misc/wifi/sockets "
                     "> /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/wpa_debug.log 2>&1 &",
                     wpa_binary_path);
            system(wpa_cmd);
            sleep(5);
        }

        if (socket_exists(WPA_SOCKET_PATH_1)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Control socket appeared after debug retry\n");
            socket_found = 1;
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] See /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/wpa_debug.log for details\n");
            g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
            goto cleanup;
        }
    }

    // Open direct UNIX socket to wpa_supplicant
    ret = wpa_ctrl_open_direct(WPA_SOCKET_PATH_1);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: failed to open wpa_ctrl socket\n");
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }
    g_sta_state = STA_STATE_WIFI_ENABLED;

    // Configure and enable target network
    ret = wpa_connect_network_direct(target_ssid, target_pass);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: wpa_connect_network_direct failed\n");
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Network configured, network_id=%d — awaiting handshake\n", ret);

    // Wait for WPA2 COMPLETED
    wpa_completed = 0;
    memset(status_buf, 0, sizeof(status_buf));

    for (int w = 0; w < 60; w++) {
        sleep(1);
        if ((w % 5) != 4) continue;

        int status = wpa_check_status_direct(status_buf, sizeof(status_buf));
        if (status == 1) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] WPA2 COMPLETED after %ds\n", w + 1);
            wpa_completed = 1;

            FILE *sf = fopen("/mnt/extsd/sta/logs/wpa_status.log", "a");
            if (sf) {
                fprintf(sf, "=== STATUS at %ds ===\n%s\n\n", w + 1, status_buf);
                fclose(sf);
            }
            break;
        }

        // IP may appear before COMPLETED (some drivers skip state transitions)
        FILE *cf = popen("ifconfig wlan0 2>/dev/null | "
                         "grep 'inet addr' | grep -v '0.0.0.0'", "r");
        if (cf) {
            char tmp[64] = {0};
            if (fgets(tmp, sizeof(tmp), cf) && strlen(tmp) > 5) {
                pclose(cf);
                fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP detected at %ds — treating as connected\n", w + 1);
                wpa_completed = 1;
                break;
            }
            pclose(cf);
        }
    }

    if (!wpa_completed) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: WPA2 did not complete in 60s\n");
        FILE *sf = fopen("/mnt/extsd/sta/logs/wpa_status_final.log", "w");
        if (sf) { fprintf(sf, "%s\n", status_buf); fclose(sf); }
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Obtain IP address (multiple methods)
    system("ifconfig wlan0 down 2>/dev/null");
    sleep(1);
    system("ifconfig wlan0 0.0.0.0 up 2>/dev/null");
    sleep(2);

    got_ip = 0;

    // dhcpcd
    ret = system("dhcpcd wlan0 > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/dhcpcd.log 2>&1 &");
    sleep(8);
    if (get_wlan0_ip(config.ipaddr, sizeof(config.ipaddr)) == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP via dhcpcd: %s\n", config.ipaddr);
        got_ip = 1;
    }

    // netcfg (Android native)
    if (!got_ip) {
        system("killall dhcpcd 2>/dev/null");
        sleep(1);
        system("netcfg wlan0 dhcp > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/netcfg.log 2>&1");
        sleep(8);
        if (get_wlan0_ip(config.ipaddr, sizeof(config.ipaddr)) == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP via netcfg: %s\n", config.ipaddr);
            got_ip = 1;
        }
    }

    // udhcpc
    if (!got_ip) {
        system("udhcpc -i wlan0 -n -t 15 > /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/udhcpc.log 2>&1");
        sleep(5);
        if (get_wlan0_ip(config.ipaddr, sizeof(config.ipaddr)) == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP via udhcpc: %s\n", config.ipaddr);
            got_ip = 1;
        }
    }

    // passive wait (wpa_supplicant internal DHCP)
    if (!got_ip) {
        for (int w = 0; w < 30; w++) {
            sleep(1);
            if (get_wlan0_ip(config.ipaddr, sizeof(config.ipaddr)) == 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP appeared passively after %ds: %s\n",
                        w + 1, config.ipaddr);
                got_ip = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // static IP fallback
    if (!got_ip) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] DHCP failed — falling back to static IP 192.168.1.250\n");
        system("ifconfig wlan0 192.168.1.250 netmask 255.255.255.0 up 2>&1");
        sleep(2);
        system("ip route add default via 192.168.1.1 dev wlan0 2>/dev/null");
        sleep(1);
        system("setprop net.dns1 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null");
        system("setprop net.dns2 8.8.4.4 2>/dev/null");
        if (get_wlan0_ip(config.ipaddr, sizeof(config.ipaddr)) == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Static IP configured: %s\n", config.ipaddr);
            got_ip = 1;
        }
    }

    if (!got_ip) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: could not obtain IP by any method\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] Logs: /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/dhcpcd.log, netcfg.log, udhcpc.log\n");
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] IP obtained: %s\n", config.ipaddr);
    g_sta_state = STA_STATE_CONNECTED;

    // Configure DNS manually.
    system("setprop net.dns1 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null");
    system("setprop net.dns2 8.8.4.4 2>/dev/null");
    system("setprop net.wlan0.dns1 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null");
    system("setprop net.wlan0.dns2 8.8.4.4 2>/dev/null");
    system("ndc resolver setifdns wlan0 8.8.8.8 8.8.4.4 2>/dev/null");
    system("ndc resolver setdefaultif wlan0 2>/dev/null");

    resolv_fp = fopen("/etc/resolv.conf", "w");
    if (resolv_fp) {
        fprintf(resolv_fp, "nameserver 8.8.8.8\nnameserver 8.8.4.4\n");
        fclose(resolv_fp);
        resolv_fp = NULL;
    }

    system("mkdir -p /data/misc/net 2>/dev/null");
    resolv_fp = fopen("/data/misc/net/resolv.conf", "w");
    if (resolv_fp) {
        fprintf(resolv_fp, "nameserver 8.8.8.8\nnameserver 8.8.4.4\n");
        fclose(resolv_fp);
        resolv_fp = NULL;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] DNS configured: 8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4\n");
    sleep(2);

    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);
    mutex_locked = 0;

    // HTTP connectivity check
    html_size = http_get_google(html_buffer, sizeof(html_buffer));
    if (html_size < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] ERROR: HTTP GET failed\n");
        g_sta_state = STA_STATE_ERROR;
        goto cleanup;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] HTTP OK — %d bytes received\n", html_size);
    g_sta_state = STA_STATE_HTTP_OK;

    // Save response to file
    save_html_to_file(html_buffer, html_size);

    fprintf(stderr, "[STA] SUCCESS — IP: %s, HTML: %d bytes\n",
            config.ipaddr, html_size);

cleanup:
    wpa_ctrl_close_direct();

    if (mutex_locked)
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_softap_mutex);

    if (g_sta_state == STA_STATE_ERROR)
        fprintf(stderr, "[STA] FAILED — check /mnt/extsd/sta/logs/*.log for diagnostics\n");

    return NULL;
}

`POC/バイバイ/main.cc`:

```cc
#include <binder/IPCThreadState.h>
#include <binder/ProcessState.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/fb.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <minigui/common.h>
#include <minigui/gdi.h>
#include <minigui/minigui.h>
#include <minigui/window.h>

#include <media/AudioTrack.h>

using namespace android;

#define WINDOW_WIDTH  320
#define WINDOW_HEIGHT 240
#define FRAME_WIDTH  320
#define FRAME_HEIGHT 240
#define BPP 2
#define FRAME_SIZE (FRAME_WIDTH * FRAME_HEIGHT * BPP)
#define FPS 30
#define FRAME_DELAY_CS (100 / FPS)
#define AUDIO_BYTES_PER_FRAME (44100 * 4 / FPS)

static const char* const DEFAULT_VID_PATH = "/mnt/extsd/video.rgb";
static const char* const DEFAULT_AUD_PATH = "/mnt/extsd/audio.pcm";

static FILE *g_vid_f = NULL;
static FILE *g_aud_f = NULL;
static sp<AudioTrack> g_track;
static unsigned char *g_frame_buf = NULL;
static unsigned char *g_audio_buf = NULL;
static HWND g_hMainWnd = HWND_INVALID;

static void *binder_thread(void *arg) {

  IPCThreadState::self()->joinThreadPool();

  return NULL;
}

static void init_binder() {

  sp<ProcessState> proc(ProcessState::self());
  ProcessState::self()->startThreadPool();

  pthread_t binder_tid;
  pthread_create(&binder_tid, NULL, binder_thread, NULL);
  pthread_detach(binder_tid);

}

static void clear_framebuffer() {

  int fd = open("/dev/graphics/fb0", O_RDWR);
  if (fd >= 0) {

    struct fb_var_screeninfo vinfo;
    struct fb_fix_screeninfo finfo;
    if (ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO, &vinfo) == 0 &&
        ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_FSCREENINFO, &finfo) == 0) {
      long screensize = vinfo.yres_virtual * finfo.line_length;
      unsigned char *fbp = reinterpret_cast<unsigned char *>(
          mmap(NULL, screensize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0));
      if (fbp != MAP_FAILED) {
        memset(fbp, 0, screensize);
        munmap(fbp, screensize);
      }
    }

    close(fd);
  }

}

static void blit_next_frame(HDC hdc) {

  if (!g_vid_f || !g_frame_buf) return;

  size_t v_read = fread(g_frame_buf, 1, FRAME_SIZE, g_vid_f);

  if (v_read < (size_t)FRAME_SIZE) {
    // Loop
    rewind(g_vid_f);
    if (g_aud_f) rewind(g_aud_f);
    if (g_track != NULL && g_track->initCheck() == NO_ERROR) {
      g_track->flush();
    }
    v_read = fread(g_frame_buf, 1, FRAME_SIZE, g_vid_f);
    if (v_read < (size_t)FRAME_SIZE) return;
  }

  // Feed audio chunk
  if (g_aud_f && g_track != NULL && g_track->initCheck() == NO_ERROR) {
    size_t a_read = fread(g_audio_buf, 1, AUDIO_BYTES_PER_FRAME, g_aud_f);
    if (a_read > 0) {
      g_track->write(g_audio_buf, a_read);
    }
  }

  unsigned short *src = reinterpret_cast<unsigned short *>(g_frame_buf);
  for (int y = 0; y < FRAME_HEIGHT; y++) {
    for (int x = 0; x < FRAME_WIDTH; x++) {
      unsigned short p = src[y * FRAME_WIDTH + x];
      unsigned int r = (p >> 11) & 0x1F;
      unsigned int g = (p >> 5)  & 0x3F;
      unsigned int b = p & 0x1F;
      r = (r << 3) | (r >> 2);
      g = (g << 2) | (g >> 4);
      b = (b << 3) | (b >> 2);
      SetPixelRGB(hdc, x, y, r, g, b);
    }
  }

}

static int ByeByeWinProc(HWND hWnd, int message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {

  HDC hdc;

  switch (message) {

    case MSG_CREATE:
      SetTimer(hWnd, 100, FRAME_DELAY_CS);
      fprintf(stderr, "[OK] Window created. Timer started (ID=100, %d cs)\n", FRAME_DELAY_CS);
      return 0;

    case MSG_TIMER:
      InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE);
      return 0;

    case MSG_PAINT: {
      hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd);
      blit_next_frame(hdc);
      EndPaint(hWnd, hdc);
      return 0;
    }

    case MSG_CLOSE:
      KillTimer(hWnd, 100);
      DestroyMainWindow(hWnd);
      PostQuitMessage(hWnd);
      return 0;

    case MSG_KEYDOWN:
    case MSG_KEYUP:
    case MSG_CHAR:
    case MSG_KEYLONGPRESS:
      return 0;

    default:
      return DefaultWindowProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);

  }

}

static int main_app(int argc, const char *argv[]) {

  MSG Msg;
  MAINWINCREATE CreateInfo;
  gal_pixel pixel;
  RGB rgb;

  fprintf(stderr, "Starting バイバイ Player GUI...\n");

  init_binder();

  const char *vid_path = DEFAULT_VID_PATH;
  const char *aud_path = DEFAULT_AUD_PATH;

  g_vid_f = fopen(vid_path, "rb");
  if (!g_vid_f) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] Cannot open video: %s\n", vid_path);
    return -1;
  }
  fprintf(stderr, "[OK] Opened video: %s\n", vid_path);

  g_aud_f = fopen(aud_path, "rb");
  if (!g_aud_f) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[WARN] Cannot open audio: %s (silent mode)\n", aud_path);
  } else {
    fprintf(stderr, "[OK] Opened audio: %s\n", aud_path);
  }

  g_frame_buf = static_cast<unsigned char *>(malloc(FRAME_SIZE));
  g_audio_buf = static_cast<unsigned char *>(malloc(AUDIO_BYTES_PER_FRAME * 2));

  g_track = new AudioTrack(

      AUDIO_STREAM_MUSIC,
      44100,
      static_cast<audio_format_t>(AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT),
      static_cast<audio_channel_mask_t>(AUDIO_CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO),
      0,
      AUDIO_OUTPUT_FLAG_NONE

  );

  if (g_track->initCheck() != NO_ERROR) {

    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] AudioTrack init failed\n");

  } else {

    g_track->start();
    fprintf(stderr, "[OK] AudioTrack started (44.1kHz 16-bit Stereo)\n");

  }

  memset(&CreateInfo, 0, sizeof(MAINWINCREATE));
  CreateInfo.dwStyle = WS_VISIBLE | WS_ABSSCRPOS;
  CreateInfo.dwExStyle = WS_EX_NONE | WS_EX_AUTOSECONDARYDC;
  CreateInfo.spCaption = "ByeBye";
  CreateInfo.hMenu = 0;
  CreateInfo.hCursor = GetSystemCursor(0);
  CreateInfo.hIcon = 0;
  CreateInfo.MainWindowProc = reinterpret_cast<WNDPROC>(ByeByeWinProc);
  CreateInfo.lx = 0;
  CreateInfo.ty = 0;
  CreateInfo.rx = WINDOW_WIDTH;
  CreateInfo.by = WINDOW_HEIGHT;

  rgb.r = 0;
  rgb.g = 0;
  rgb.b = 0;
  RGBA2Pixels(HDC_SCREEN, &rgb, &pixel, 1);
  CreateInfo.iBkColor = pixel;
  CreateInfo.dwAddData = 0;
  CreateInfo.hHosting = HWND_DESKTOP;

  g_hMainWnd = CreateMainWindowEx(&CreateInfo, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (g_hMainWnd == HWND_INVALID) {

    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] Window creation failed\n");

    return -1;
  }

  ShowWindow(g_hMainWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
  SetFocus(g_hMainWnd);

  fprintf(stderr, "[OK] Window visible. Entering message loop...\n");

  while (GetMessage(&Msg, g_hMainWnd)) {

    TranslateMessage(&Msg);
    DispatchMessage(&Msg);

  }

  MainWindowThreadCleanup(g_hMainWnd);

  free(g_frame_buf);
  free(g_audio_buf);
  fclose(g_vid_f);
  if (g_aud_f) fclose(g_aud_f);

  return 0;
}

extern "C" int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {

  clear_framebuffer();

  if (InitGUI(argc, argv)) {

    fprintf(stderr, "[ERROR] Failed to initialize MiniGUI\n");

    return 1;
  }

  int ret = main_app(argc, argv);

  TerminateGUI(0);

  return ret;
}

```

```md
# Lelouch: Pesquisa de Firmware e Firmware Customizado para a SJCAM SJ4000

[![CI](https://github.com/keowu/sjcam/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/keowu/sjcam/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

![Banner do projeto Lelouch](imgs/intro.png)

[Switch to English version](README.md)

Notas de engenharia reversa, ferramentas para firmware, código de prova de conceito e uma interface de firmware customizada para a versão Allwinner V3 da SJCAM SJ4000 Air.

> **Artigo da pesquisa**
>
> Este repositório contém o código e os artefatos produzidos durante a pesquisa. O artigo completo explica a investigação desde o primeiro dump do firmware até o firmware customizado Lelouch.
>
> [Leia o artigo completo da pesquisa em inglês](https://keowu.re/posts/Lelouch--Reverse-Engineering-of-an-SJCAM-Action-Camera-with-proprietary-Android--based-firmware-and-Rewriting-a-completely-OpenSource-CFW) ou [português](https://keowu.re/posts/Lelouch--Engenharia-Reversa-de-uma-SJCAM-Action-Camera-com-firmware-propriet%C3%A1rio-baseado-no-Android-e-Reescrevendo-um-CFW-completamente-OpenSource).

## Sobre o projeto

Este trabalho começou com uma pergunta simples: quanto controle eu conseguiria obter sobre uma action camera barata sem documentação, código-fonte ou suporte do fabricante?

Descobri que a câmera utiliza um SoC Allwinner V3 e um sistema Android 4.4 fortemente modificado. Sua aplicação principal, `sdv`, comunica-se com serviços proprietários de câmera e display por meio do Binder, renderiza a interface com MiniGUI, expõe um servidor HTTP para atualizações de firmware e comunica-se com o aplicativo SJCAM Zone por meio de um protocolo proprietário.

O repositório documenta o caminho desde a extração do firmware até uma substituição funcional para o `sdv`. Ele inclui ferramentas para os formatos de firmware encontrados durante a pesquisa, bancos de dados do IDA para os binários revertidos, um cliente AVIOCTRL, o código-fonte do firmware customizado Lelouch e a prova de conceito associada à CVE-2026-52656.

O código tem como alvo a placa Allwinner V3 pesquisada, com controlador de display ST7789V e sensor de imagem GC4653. Unidades SJ4000 mais antigas, baseadas no Novatek NT9665X, estão incluídas somente como parte da pesquisa anterior e utilizam um formato de firmware diferente. Apenas o nome do produto não é suficiente para determinar a compatibilidade.

## Lelouch

Lelouch é uma interface substituta para o executável `sdv` original da câmera. Ele é compilado com as bibliotecas proprietárias recuperadas do firmware e utiliza as mesmas interfaces internas da aplicação original.

A implementação atual inclui:

- Preview da câmera por meio das interfaces revertidas `HerbCamera` e `CedarDisplay`
- Uma interface MiniGUI projetada para o display de 320x240 da câmera e seus botões físicos
- Controle do hotspot Wi-Fi por meio da camada de abstração de hardware da Allwinner
- Modo estação Wi-Fi utilizando uma compilação ARMv7 customizada do `wpa_supplicant`
- Um pequeno navegador de texto com teclado no próprio dispositivo
- Detecção de movimento nos frames do preview e código experimental de detecção facial com Haar cascade
- Telas de status da bateria, horário, câmera, rede e depuração
- Inicialização do Binder e comunicação com os serviços já presentes no firmware

Lelouch não é uma distribuição completa nem um firmware genérico para todos os produtos vendidos como SJ4000. Ele depende das bibliotecas, kernel, serviços, layout de partições, controlador de display, sensor de imagem e configuração de placa utilizados na unidade Allwinner V3 pesquisada.

## Estrutura do repositório

| Caminho | Conteúdo |
| --- | --- |
| `Lelouch/` | Interface do firmware customizado, ambiente de compilação, headers recuperados, bibliotecas compartilhadas proprietárias e código-fonte modificado do `wpa_supplicant` |
| `Reversing Scripts/` | Parsers e repackers para firmwares Allwinner IMAGEWTY, Allwinner eGON e Novatek BCL1 |
| `AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py` | Cliente interativo para o protocolo TCP proprietário utilizado pelo SJCAM Zone |
| `Bin Files/` | Bancos de dados do IDA para os principais executáveis e bibliotecas compartilhadas analisados durante a pesquisa |
| `Firmwares Files/` | Amostras de firmware Allwinner e Novatek utilizadas durante o desenvolvimento |
| `POC/` | Prova de conceito da CVE-2026-52656, imagem eGON modificada e payload de demonstração para framebuffer e áudio |

Alguns diretórios contêm material proprietário ou de terceiros recuperado do dispositivo. Sua presença destina-se à interoperabilidade e pesquisa de segurança e não torna esses componentes código aberto.

## Compilando o Lelouch

A compilação foi testada em Linux x86-64. Você precisa do Python 3, GNU Make, Git, um ambiente de compilação C/C++ e acesso à rede para o download inicial do toolchain.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/keowu/sjcam.git
cd sjcam/Lelouch
python3 prepare_build.py
```

O `prepare_build.py` baixa um sysroot fixado no Android API level 14 e o cross-compiler ARM `arm-linux-androideabi-4.6` para `Lelouch/android_compilers/`. Em seguida, ele compila o `wpa_supplicant` estático modificado e executa o `make`. Os arquivos de compilador baixados e os binários gerados são ignorados pelo Git.

Os arquivos resultantes são:

```text
Lelouch/Lelouch
Lelouch/wpa_supplicant
```

Para recompilar após alterar os códigos-fonte C++:

```bash
cd Lelouch
make clean
make
```

O binário `Lelouch` gerado deve substituir `/bin/sdv` no sistema de arquivos raiz extraído. O modo estação Wi-Fi também espera encontrar o `wpa_supplicant` compilado em `/mnt/extsd/sta/wpa_supplicant` no cartão SD da câmera.

O código experimental de detecção facial procura pelo arquivo cascade gerado em:

```text
/mnt/extsd/frontalface.casc
```

O repositório inclui um cascade pré-gerado e o conversor utilizado para criá-lo:

```bash
cd Lelouch/gen_cascade
python3 gen_cascade.py haarcascade_frontalface_alt2.xml frontalface.casc
```

O procedimento completo de extração, substituição do sistema de arquivos raiz, reempacotamento e flash com LiveSuit está documentado no artigo da pesquisa vinculado no início desta página.

## Ferramentas de firmware

Todos os pontos de entrada dos parsers são scripts Python 3 com saída de ajuda integrada por meio de `--help` e não possuem dependências Python de terceiros.

### Allwinner IMAGEWTY

Lê a imagem externa de firmware do LiveSuit, extrai seus arquivos e reconstrói uma imagem a partir de um diretório extraído.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" info firmware.img
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" extract firmware.img -o image_dump
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" repack image_dump rebuilt.img
```

### Allwinner eGON

Inspeciona, extrai e reempacota o container `full_img.fex` encontrado dentro da imagem IMAGEWTY.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" info full_img.fex
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" extract full_img.fex -o egon_dump
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" pack egon_dump \
  --original full_img.fex \
  -o rebuilt_full_img.fex
```

O packer utiliza o arquivo original como modelo para preservar o layout e os metadados originais enquanto as partições são substituídas.

### Novatek BCL1

Descompacta o container BCL1 utilizado por firmwares de modelos SJ4000 mais antigos baseados no Novatek e pode procurar no resultado por assets e seções de firmware incorporados.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/Novatek もな BCL1 - Firmware Parser/main.py" \
  "Firmwares Files/OLD_SJCAM_Novatek_NT9665X/SJCAM001.bin" \
  -o firmCode.bin \
  --extract
```

## Cliente AVIOCTRL

O `ウタ.py` implementa o protocolo TCP proprietário utilizado pelo aplicativo móvel para controlar a câmera pela porta `6666`. Ele implementa a sequência de login da câmera, mensagens de keepalive, frames IOCTRL, transferência de arquivos e solicitações do stream de vídeo utilizando somente a biblioteca padrão do Python.

Conecte seu computador à rede Wi-Fi da câmera e execute:

```bash
python3 "AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py"
```

O destino padrão é `192.168.100.1:6666`. Um endereço diferente pode ser fornecido quando necessário:

```bash
python3 "AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py" --host 192.168.100.1 --port 6666 --debug
```

O cliente interativo pode ler a bateria e as configurações, inspecionar o cartão SD, tirar fotos, iniciar ou interromper gravações, listar, enviar, baixar ou excluir arquivos, solicitar thumbnails, configurar o Wi-Fi, solicitar o stream de vídeo e enviar comandos IOCTRL manualmente.

Formatar o cartão SD, excluir arquivos, alterar as configurações de Wi-Fi e executar uma restauração de fábrica modificam a câmera. Utilize esses comandos somente em hardware e dados que pertençam a você.

## CVE-2026-52656

O firmware pesquisado expõe um endpoint HTTP sem autenticação enquanto o hotspot da câmera está ativo. Ele aceita uploads arbitrários de arquivos e os grava diretamente no cartão SD sem validar o cliente ou o conteúdo enviado. Isso permite a substituição completa do firmware, pois um atacante pode enviar uma imagem eGON customizada chamada `full_img.fex`; a câmera reconhece esse nome de arquivo como um pacote OTA e instala o firmware controlado pelo atacante por meio de seu fluxo normal de atualização, como se fosse uma atualização oficial.

A exploração bem-sucedida concede ao firmware enviado controle total sobre o software em execução no dispositivo. A prova de conceito incluída demonstra isso substituindo a aplicação original por um payload customizado que utiliza MiniGUI e AudioTrack para reproduzir o vídeo *Bad Apple!!* com frames RGB565 e áudio PCM brutos após a instalação da imagem OTA maliciosa.

O diretório `POC/` contém:

- `run_exploit.sh`, que envia o `full_img.fex` controlado pelo atacante para a câmera
- `full_img.fex`, a imagem de firmware eGON modificada aceita pelo mecanismo de atualização OTA da câmera
- `バイバイ/`, o payload MiniGUI e AudioTrack do *Bad Apple!!* utilizado para demonstrar execução arbitrária de código após a atualização
- `extract_rgb_pcm_from_mp4/`, um auxiliar para converter o vídeo de demonstração em dados RGB565 e PCM brutos

O auxiliar de conversão de mídia requer o `ffmpeg`. O payload de demonstração espera encontrar os arquivos `video.rgb` e `audio.pcm` gerados na raiz do cartão SD da câmera.

A prova de conceito é destrutiva por natureza. Uma imagem malformada ou incompatível pode inutilizar permanentemente a câmera. Não a execute contra dispositivos que não pertençam a você ou sem um procedimento completo de recuperação.

## Escopo da pesquisa

O projeto foi criado para engenharia reversa, interoperabilidade, educação e pesquisa de segurança em hardware adquirido legalmente pelo autor. SJCAM, Allwinner, Novatek, Android e os nomes de seus componentes pertencem aos seus respectivos proprietários.

O repositório contém código-fonte original junto com amostras de firmware, bancos de dados de engenharia reversa, headers e bibliotecas compartilhadas originários de produtos de terceiros. Nenhuma licença é concedida para o material de terceiros. Verifique a procedência e a legislação aplicável antes de redistribuir ou utilizar esses arquivos fora de um ambiente de pesquisa.

Atualmente, não existe uma licença de código aberto aplicável a todo o repositório. O código-fonte do `wpa_supplicant` mantém sua própria licença upstream em `Lelouch/modified_lelouch_wpa_supplicant_source/COPYING`.

```md
# Lelouch: SJCAM SJ4000 Firmware Research and Custom Firmware

[![CI](https://github.com/keowu/sjcam/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/keowu/sjcam/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

![Lelouch project banner](imgs/intro.png)

[Trocar para Português (Brasil)](README-pt-br.md)

Reverse engineering notes, firmware tooling, proof-of-concept code, and a custom firmware interface for the Allwinner V3 version of the SJCAM SJ4000 Air.

> **Research article**
>
> This repository contains the code and artifacts produced during the research. The full article explains the investigation from the first firmware dump to the Lelouch custom firmware.
>
> [Read the complete research article in English](https://keowu.re/posts/Lelouch--Reverse-Engineering-of-an-SJCAM-Action-Camera-with-proprietary-Android--based-firmware-and-Rewriting-a-completely-OpenSource-CFW)) or [Portuguese](https://keowu.re/posts/Lelouch--Engenharia-Reversa-de-uma-SJCAM-Action-Camera-com-firmware-propriet%C3%A1rio-baseado-no-Android-e-Reescrevendo-um-CFW-completamente-OpenSource).

## About the project

This work started with a simple question: how much control could I get over a cheap action camera without documentation, source code, or vendor support?

The camera turned out to use an Allwinner V3 SoC and a heavily modified Android 4.4 system. Its main application, `sdv`, talks to proprietary camera and display services through Binder, renders the interface with MiniGUI, exposes an HTTP server for firmware updates, and communicates with the SJCAM Zone application through a proprietary protocol.

The repository documents the path from firmware extraction to a working replacement for `sdv`. It includes tools for the firmware formats encountered during the research, IDA databases for the reversed binaries, an AVIOCTRL client, the Lelouch custom firmware source, and the proof of concept associated with CVE-2026-52656.

The code targets the researched Allwinner V3 board with an ST7789V display controller and GC4653 image sensor. Older SJ4000 units based on Novatek NT9665X are included only as part of the earlier research and use a different firmware format. Product names alone are not enough to establish compatibility.

## Lelouch

Lelouch is a replacement interface for the camera's original `sdv` executable. It is built against the proprietary libraries recovered from the firmware and uses the same internal interfaces as the original application.

The current implementation includes:

- Camera preview through the reversed `HerbCamera` and `CedarDisplay` interfaces
- A MiniGUI interface designed for the camera's 320x240 display and physical buttons
- Wi-Fi hotspot control through the Allwinner hardware abstraction layer
- Wi-Fi station mode using a custom ARMv7 build of `wpa_supplicant`
- A small text browser with an on-device keyboard
- Motion detection on preview frames and experimental Haar cascade face detection code
- Battery, time, camera, network, and debug status views
- Binder initialization and communication with the services already present in the firmware

Lelouch is not a complete distribution or a generic firmware for every product sold as an SJ4000. It depends on the libraries, kernel, services, partition layout, display controller, image sensor, and board configuration used by the researched Allwinner V3 unit.

## Repository layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `Lelouch/` | Custom firmware interface, build environment, recovered headers, proprietary shared libraries, and modified `wpa_supplicant` source |
| `Reversing Scripts/` | Parsers and repackers for Allwinner IMAGEWTY, Allwinner eGON, and Novatek BCL1 firmware |
| `AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py` | Interactive client for the proprietary TCP protocol used by SJCAM Zone |
| `Bin Files/` | IDA databases for the main executables and shared libraries analyzed during the research |
| `Firmwares Files/` | Allwinner and Novatek firmware samples used during development |
| `POC/` | CVE-2026-52656 proof of concept, crafted eGON image, and the framebuffer/audio demo payload |

Some directories contain third-party or proprietary material recovered from the device. Their presence is for interoperability and security research and does not make those components open source.

## Building Lelouch

The build was tested on x86-64 Linux. You need Python 3, GNU Make, Git, a C/C++ build environment, and network access for the initial toolchain download.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/keowu/sjcam.git
cd sjcam/Lelouch
python3 prepare_build.py
```

`prepare_build.py` downloads a pinned Android API level 14 sysroot and the ARM `arm-linux-androideabi-4.6` cross-compiler into `Lelouch/android_compilers/`. It then builds the modified static `wpa_supplicant` and runs `make`. The downloaded compiler files and generated binaries are ignored by Git.

The resulting files are:

```text
Lelouch/Lelouch
Lelouch/wpa_supplicant
```

To rebuild after changing the C++ sources:

```bash
cd Lelouch
make clean
make
```

The generated `Lelouch` binary is intended to replace `/bin/sdv` in the extracted root filesystem. Wi-Fi station mode also expects the built `wpa_supplicant` at `/mnt/extsd/sta/wpa_supplicant` on the camera's SD card.

The experimental face detection code looks for the generated cascade file at:

```text
/mnt/extsd/frontalface.casc
```

The repository includes a pre-generated cascade and the converter used to create it:

```bash
cd Lelouch/gen_cascade
python3 gen_cascade.py haarcascade_frontalface_alt2.xml frontalface.casc
```

The complete extraction, root filesystem replacement, repacking, and LiveSuit flashing procedure is documented in the research article linked at the top of this page.

## Firmware tools

All parser entry points are Python 3 scripts with built-in `--help` output and no third-party Python dependencies.

### Allwinner IMAGEWTY

Reads the outer LiveSuit firmware image, extracts its files, and rebuilds an image from an extracted directory.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" info firmware.img
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" extract firmware.img -o image_dump
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner IMAGEWTY - ROM Parser/main.py" repack image_dump rebuilt.img
```

### Allwinner eGON

Inspects, extracts, and repacks the `full_img.fex` container found inside the IMAGEWTY image.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" info full_img.fex
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" extract full_img.fex -o egon_dump
python3 "Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/main.py" pack egon_dump \
  --original full_img.fex \
  -o rebuilt_full_img.fex
```

The packer uses the original file as a template so that the original layout and metadata can be preserved while partitions are replaced.

### Novatek BCL1

Decompresses the BCL1 container used by older Novatek-based SJ4000 firmware and can scan the result for embedded assets and firmware sections.

```bash
python3 "Reversing Scripts/Novatek もな BCL1 - Firmware Parser/main.py" \
  "Firmwares Files/OLD_SJCAM_Novatek_NT9665X/SJCAM001.bin" \
  -o firmCode.bin \
  --extract
```

## AVIOCTRL client

`ウタ.py` implements the proprietary TCP protocol used by the mobile application to control the camera on port `6666`. It handles the camera's login sequence, keepalive messages, IOCTRL frames, file transfer, and video stream requests using only the Python standard library.

Connect your computer to the camera's Wi-Fi network and run:

```bash
python3 "AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py"
```

The default target is `192.168.100.1:6666`. A different address can be supplied when required:

```bash
python3 "AVIOCTRL Script/ウタ.py" --host 192.168.100.1 --port 6666 --debug
```

The interactive client can read the battery and configuration, inspect the SD card, take photos, start or stop recording, list, upload, download, or delete files, request thumbnails, configure Wi-Fi, request the video stream, and send manual IOCTRL commands.

Formatting the SD card, deleting files, changing Wi-Fi settings, and performing a factory reset modify the camera. Use those commands only on hardware and data you own.

## CVE-2026-52656

The researched firmware exposes an unauthenticated HTTP endpoint while the camera hotspot is active. It accepts arbitrary file uploads and writes them directly to the SD card without validating either the client or the uploaded content. This enables complete firmware replacement because an attacker can upload a custom eGON image named `full_img.fex`; the camera recognizes that filename as an OTA package and installs the attacker-controlled firmware through its normal update flow, as though it were an official update.

Successful exploitation gives the uploaded firmware full control over the software running on the device. The included proof of concept demonstrates this by replacing the original application with a custom MiniGUI/AudioTrack payload that plays the *Bad Apple!!* video using raw RGB565 frames and PCM audio after the malicious OTA image is installed.

The `POC/` directory contains:

- `run_exploit.sh`, which uploads the attacker-controlled `full_img.fex` to the camera
- `full_img.fex`, the crafted eGON firmware image accepted by the camera's OTA update mechanism
- `バイバイ/`, the MiniGUI and AudioTrack *Bad Apple!!* payload used to demonstrate arbitrary code execution after the update
- `extract_rgb_pcm_from_mp4/`, a helper for converting the demonstration video into raw RGB565 and PCM data

The media conversion helper requires `ffmpeg`. The generated `video.rgb` and `audio.pcm` files are expected at the root of the camera's SD card by the demonstration payload.

The proof of concept is destructive by nature. A malformed or incompatible image can permanently brick the camera. Do not run it against devices you do not own or without a complete recovery path.

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
import struct
import json
import hashlib
from .constants import *
from .models import EgonHeader, EgonPartition, EgonFirmware
from .core import parse_egon_firmware
from .checksum import verify_egon_checksum, update_egon_checksum

def egon_header_info(filepath: Path):

    if not filepath.exists():
        print(f"File does not exist: {filepath}")
        return

    with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    # Format: I=uint32_t, 8s=8 bytes, I=uint32_t, I=uint32_t, 4s=4 bytes, 13I=uint32_t
    unpacked = struct.unpack("<I8sII4sIIIII52s", data[:HEADER_SIZE])

    # Parse data based on EgonHeader
    header = EgonHeader(
        b_instructions=unpacked[0],
        magic=unpacked[1],
        check_sum=unpacked[2],
        length=unpacked[3],
        spl_signature=unpacked[4],
        fel_script_address=unpacked[5],
        fel_uEnv_length=unpacked[6],
        dt_name_offset=unpacked[7],
        dram_size=unpacked[8],
        boot_media=unpacked[9],
        string_pool=unpacked[10]
    )

    if header.is_valid():
        #print(header.to_dict())

        print("="*50)
        print(" eGON Image Information")
        print("="*50)
        print(f"Payload Size: {header.get_payload_size()}")
        print(f"    B Instructions: {header.b_instructions}")
        print(f"    Valid: {header.is_valid()}")
        print(f"    Magic: {header.get_magic_str()}")
        print(f"    Checksum: {header.check_sum:08X}")
        print(f"    Length: {header.length}")
        print(f"    SPL Signature: {header.get_spl_signature_str()}")
        print(f"    FEL Script Address: {header.fel_script_address}")
        print(f"    FEL uEnv Length: {header.fel_uEnv_length}")
        print(f"    DT Name Offset: {header.dt_name_offset}")
        print(f"    DRAM Size: {header.dram_size}")
        print(f"    Boot Media: {header.get_boot_media_name()}")
        print(f"    String Pool: {header.string_pool.hex()}")

        if header.dt_name_offset > 0 and header.dt_name_offset < header.length:
            offset = 0 # Fix: offset was undefined in original code
            dt_offset = offset + header.dt_name_offset
            if dt_offset < len(data):
                dt_end = data.find(b'\x00', dt_offset)
                if dt_end > dt_offset:
                    dt_name = data[dt_offset:dt_end].decode('utf-8')
                    print(f"    DT Name: {dt_name}")
    print("="*50)

    f.close()

def egon_firmware_info(filepath: Path):

    if not filepath.exists():
        print(f"File does not exist: {filepath}")
        return

    with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    fw = parse_egon_firmware(filepath, data)

    # Printing the firmware info
    print(f"\n{'-'*60}")
    print(f"  File:       {fw.filename}")
    print(f"  Size:       {fw.total_size:,} bytes ({fw.total_size / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB)")
    print(f"  Partitions: {len(fw.partitions)}")
    print()

    print(f"{'-'*60}")
    print(f" Partition Table")
    print(f"{'-'*60}")
    print(f" {'Name':<12} {'Offset':<12} {'Size':<12} {'Type':<15}")
    print(f" {'-'*12} {'-'*12} {'-'*12} {'-'*15}")
    
    for p in fw.partitions:
        size_str = f"{p.size:,}" if p.size < 1024*1024 else f"{p.size/1024/1024:.1f}M"
        print(f" {p.name:<12} 0x{p.offset:08X}  {size_str:<12} {p.type:<15}")
    
    print()
    
    for p in fw.partitions:
        if p.metadata:
            print(f"--- {p.name} ({p.type}) ---")
            for key, value in p.metadata.items():
                if key not in ('magic',):
                    print(f"  {key}: {value}")
            print()
    
    if fw.gaps:
        print(f"{'-'*60}")
        print(f" Declarated but Unallocated Regions present on this eGON firmware")
        print(f"{'-'*60}")
        for offset, size in fw.gaps:
            print(f"  0x{offset:08X} - 0x{offset+size:08X} ({size:,} bytes)")

    f.close()

def egon_firmware_extract(filepath: Path, output_dir: Path):
    
    if not filepath.exists():
        print(f"File does not exist: {filepath}")
        return

    with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    fw = parse_egon_firmware(filepath, data)

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    print(f"\nOutput directory: {output_dir}\n")
    
    # Save firmware info as JSON
    info_path = output_dir / "firmware_info.json"
    with open(info_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(fw.to_dict(), f, indent=2)
    print(f"Saved: firmware_info.json")
    
    # Extract each partition
    for p in fw.partitions:
        
        ext_map = {
            'egon': '.bin',
            'android_boot': '.img', 
            'squashfs': '.sqfs',
            'jffs2': '.jffs2',
            'jpeg': '.jpg',
        }

        ext = ext_map.get(p.type, '.bin')
        
        part_filename = f"{p.name}{ext}"
        part_path = output_dir / part_filename
        
        with open(part_path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(p.data)
        
        # Also save partition metadata
        meta_path = output_dir / f"{p.name}.json"
        with open(meta_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(p.to_dict(), f, indent=2)
        
        print(f"Saved: {part_filename} ({len(p.data):,} bytes)")
    
    # Extract gaps (unallocated/reserved regions)
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    for i, (offset, size) in enumerate(fw.gaps):
        if size > 0:
            gap_path = output_dir / f"gap_{i}_0x{offset:X}.bin"
            with open(gap_path, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(data[offset:offset+size])
            print(f"Saved: gap_{i}_0x{offset:X}.bin ({size:,} bytes)")
    
    print(f"\nExtraction complete!")

def get_file_md5(path: Path) -> str:
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return hashlib.md5(f.read()).hexdigest()

def egon_firmware_pack(input_dir: Path, output_path: Path, original_firmware: Path = None):
    
    if not input_dir.exists():
        print(f"Error: Directory not found: {input_dir}")
        return
    
    info_path = input_dir / "firmware_info.json"
    
    if not info_path.exists():
        print("Error: firmware_info.json not found")
        return
    
    with open(info_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        fw_info = json.load(f)
    
    original_size = fw_info['total_size']
    
    if original_firmware and original_firmware.exists():
        print(f"Loading original firmware template: {original_firmware}")
        with open(original_firmware, 'rb') as f:
            output = bytearray(f.read())
        
        if len(output) < original_size:
            print(f"Error: Original firmware file is too small! (Size: {len(output)}, Required: {original_size})")
            print("The file has no space to be included. Please provide the correct original firmware.")
            return
        elif len(output) > original_size:
            print(f"Warning: Original size ({len(output)}) > Info total_size ({original_size}).")
    else:
        output = bytearray(original_size)
    
    print(f"Packing firmware: {output_path}")
    
    sorted_partitions = sorted(fw_info['partitions'], key=lambda x: int(x['offset'], 16))
    
    boot0_modified = False

    for i, p_info in enumerate(sorted_partitions):
        name = p_info['name']
        offset = int(p_info['offset'], 16)
        p_type = p_info['type']
        stored_md5 = p_info.get('md5')
        
        ext_map = {
            'egon': '.bin',
            'android_boot': '.img',
            'squashfs': '.sqfs',
            'jffs2': '.jffs2',
            'jpeg': '.jpg',
        }

        ext = ext_map.get(p_type, '.bin')
        part_path = input_dir / f"{name}{ext}"
        
        if not part_path.exists():
            print(f"Warning: {part_path} not found, skipping")
            continue
        
        # Only patch if MD5 from the current file on disk and from eGON firmware info has changed
        current_md5 = get_file_md5(part_path)
        
        if original_firmware and stored_md5 and current_md5 == stored_md5:
            print(f"  {name}: Unchanged, skipping")
            continue
        
        print(f"  {name}: Modified, patching...")
        if p_type == 'egon':
            boot0_modified = True

        with open(part_path, 'rb') as f:
            part_data = f.read()
        
        if p_type == 'egon':
            # Only update length and checksum if we are actually modifying eGON partition
            if len(part_data) >= 20:
                struct.pack_into('<I', part_data := bytearray(part_data), 16, len(part_data))
            part_data = update_egon_checksum(bytes(part_data))
            print(f"    Updated eGON checksum for {name}")
        
        # Determine the "Slot" boundary (space reserved for this partition)
        # It's from current offset to the next partition start
        if i + 1 < len(sorted_partitions):
            slot_end = int(sorted_partitions[i+1]['offset'], 16)
        else:
            slot_end = len(output)

        # Write data to offset
        end_data = offset + len(part_data)
        
        if end_data > slot_end:
             print(f"Warning: {name} exceeds its slot! Truncating to fit.")
             part_data = part_data[:slot_end - offset]
             end_data = slot_end

        output[offset:end_data] = part_data
        
        # Zero-pad the rest of the slot to ensure clean overwrite (mimicking manual hex-edit)
        if end_data < slot_end:
            pad_len = slot_end - end_data
            output[end_data:slot_end] = b'\x00' * pad_len
            print(f"    Padded {pad_len} bytes until next partition/EOF")

    # Handle gaps (only if not patching OR if manually modified)
    # Gaps are treated like partitions: if gap file exists and changed, overwrite original gap area.
    for i, gap_info in enumerate(fw_info.get('gaps', [])):
        offset = gap_info[0]
        gap_path = input_dir / f"gap_{i}_0x{offset:X}.bin"
        
        if gap_path.exists():
            # Check if gap was modified
            # Gaps don't have MD5 in info by default in current logic, 
            # but we can check if it matches the current template bytes.
            with open(gap_path, 'rb') as f:
                gap_data = f.read()
            
            if original_firmware and output[offset:offset+len(gap_data)] == gap_data:
                # print(f"  Gap {i}: Unchanged")
                pass
            else:
                print(f"  Gap {i}: Patching...")
                output[offset:offset + len(gap_data)] = gap_data
                
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(output)
    
    print(f"\nCreated: {output_path} ({len(output):,} bytes)")
    
    if len(output) > 20 and output[4:12] == BOOT0_MAGIC:
        egon_len = struct.unpack('<I', output[16:20])[0]
        if verify_egon_checksum(bytes(output[:egon_len])):
            print("  eGON Header checksum: [OK]")
        else:
            if boot0_modified:
                print("  eGON Header checksum: [FAIL]")
            else:
                print("  eGON Header checksum: [Original Preserved]")

    print(f"\nPack complete!")

def egon_add_file_padding(filepath: Path, target_size_str: str, output_path: Optional[Path] = None):

    if not filepath.exists():
        print(f"Error: File '{filepath}' not found!")
        return

    # Convert target_size to int if it's a hex string
    try:
        if target_size_str.startswith("0x"):
            target_size = int(target_size_str, 16)
        else:
            target_size = int(target_size_str)
    except ValueError:
        print(f"Error: Invalid target size format: {target_size_str}")
        return

    current_size = filepath.stat().st_size
    
    print(f"Current size: 0x{current_size:X} ({current_size:,} bytes)")
    print(f"Target size:  0x{target_size:X} ({target_size:,} bytes)")
    
    if current_size >= target_size:
        print("File is already equal to or larger than the target size. No padding added.")
        return
    
    padding_size = target_size - current_size
    print(f"Adding: 0x{padding_size:X} ({padding_size:,} bytes) of null padding")
    
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    padded_data = data + b'\x00' * padding_size
    
    if output_path is None:
        
        stem = filepath.stem
        suffix = filepath.suffix

        if suffix == '.bin':
            output_path = filepath.with_name(f"{stem}_padded{suffix}")
        else:
            output_path = filepath.with_name(f"{filepath.name}_padded")
            
    with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(padded_data)
    
    print(f"File saved as: {output_path}")
    print(f"New size: 0x{len(padded_data):X} ({len(padded_data):,} bytes)")

`Reversing Scripts/AllWinner EGON - Firmware Parser/egon_parser/checksum.py`:

```py
import struct
from .constants import STAMP_VALUE

def calculate_egon_checksum(data: bytes) -> int:
    
    if len(data) % 4 != 0:
        data = data + b'\x00' * (4 - len(data) % 4)
    
    checksum = STAMP_VALUE
    for i in range(0, len(data), 4):
        word = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, i)[0]
        checksum = (checksum + word) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    return checksum


def update_egon_checksum(data: bytes) -> bytes:

    data = bytearray(data)
    struct.pack_into('<I', data, 0x0C, STAMP_VALUE)
    new_checksum = calculate_egon_checksum(bytes(data))
    struct.pack_into('<I', data, 0x0C, new_checksum)
    return bytes(data)

def verify_egon_checksum(data: bytes) -> bool:

    if len(data) < 20:
        return False

    stored = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 0x0C)[0]
    data_copy = bytearray(data)
    struct.pack_into('<I', data_copy, 0x0C, STAMP_VALUE)
    calculated = calculate_egon_checksum(bytes(data_copy))

    return stored == calculated

```

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from .actions import egon_header_info, egon_firmware_info, egon_firmware_extract, egon_firmware_pack, egon_add_file_padding

def main():
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AllWinner EGON Firmware Parser")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version="AllWinner EGON Firmware Parser 0.1")
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", help="Command to execute")
    
    parser_header = subparsers.add_parser("header", help="Show eGON header info")
    parser_header.add_argument("file", type=Path, help="Input firmware file")
    
    parser_info = subparsers.add_parser("info", help="Show full firmware info")
    parser_info.add_argument("file", type=Path, help="Input firmware file")
    
    parser_extract = subparsers.add_parser("extract", help="Extract firmware partitions")
    parser_extract.add_argument("file", type=Path, help="Input firmware file")
    parser_extract.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, default=Path("extracted"), help="Output directory")
    
    parser_pack = subparsers.add_parser("pack", help="Pack firmware from extracted files")
    parser_pack.add_argument("input_dir", type=Path, help="Directory containing extracted files and info")
    parser_pack.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, default=Path("new_firmware.fex"), help="Output firmware file")
    parser_pack.add_argument("--original", type=Path, required=True, help="Original firmware file to use as template (patch mode)")
    
    parser_padd = subparsers.add_parser("padd", help="Add null padding to a file (aumenta)")
    parser_padd.add_argument("file", type=Path, help="Input file to pad")
    parser_padd.add_argument("size", type=str, help="Target size (hex 0x... or decimal)")
    parser_padd.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, help="Output file path (optional)")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.command == "header":
        egon_header_info(args.file)
    elif args.command == "info":
        egon_firmware_info(args.file)
    elif args.command == "extract":
        egon_firmware_extract(args.file, args.output)
    elif args.command == "pack":
        egon_firmware_pack(args.input_dir, args.output, args.original)
    elif args.command == "padd":
        egon_add_file_padding(args.file, args.size, args.output)
    else:
        parser.print_help()

    0x00: "MMC0",
    0x01: "NAND",

    0x03: "SPI",

BOOT0_MAGIC = b"eGON.BT0"
BOOT1_MAGIC = b"eGON.BT1"
BROM_MAGIC = b"eGON.BRM"
ANDROID_MAGIC = b"ANDROID!"
SQUASHFS_MAGIC = b"hsqs"
SQUASHFS_MAGIC_BE = b"sqsh"
JFFS2_MAGIC_LE = 0x1985
JFFS2_MAGIC_BE = 0x8519
JPEG_MAGIC = b"\xff\xd8\xff"

HEADER_SIZE = 96
